Nate, ensonga ezigabanibwa abaweereza n’abantu baabwe zirina enkolagana ya butereevu n’ensonga z’olunaku olw’okusalirako omusango, kubanga omulimu gw’abaweereza n’abantu baabwe kwe kukuza obulokozi obutaggwaawo obw’emmeeme z’abantu n’okuwona kwabwe okuva mu kuzikirira okutaggwaawo; era olunaku olw’okusalirako omusango lwe lunaku olwalondebwa olw’ekyo, okusalawo mu lwatu n’okunyweza embeera y’abantu etaggwaawo, okuteeka abamu mu mbeera ey’obulokozi obutaggwaawo n’okutuusa obulokozi bwabwe ku ntikko yaabwo esingayo, n’okuteeka abalala mu mbeera ey’okuzikirira okutaggwaawo n’obunaku obutuukiridde ennyo. Ensonga ezigabanibwa abaweereza n’abantu zirina enkolagana esinga obutereevu n’olunaku olw’okusalirako omusango, kubanga ekigendererwa kyennyini eky’omulimu gw’obuweereza kwe kwetegekera kw’abantu olunaku olwo. Abaweereza batumibwa okubalabula ku kusembera kw’olunaku olwo, okubalabula nga bukyali ku musango ogw’entiisa ogulisalirwa ababi mu kiseera ekyo, n’okubalangirira omusango ogw’omukisa ogulisalirwa abatuukirivu mu kiseera ekyo, n’okukozesa amakubo nabo basobole okuwona obusungu obulijja ku batatya Katonda mu kiseera ekyo, n’okufuna empeera eriweebwa abatukuvu mu kiseera ekyo.

Era nga ensonga ezigabanibwa abaweereza n’abantu baabwe bwe zirina enkolagana ey’okumpi bw’etyo era eya butereevu n’olunaku olwo, kisaanidde nnyo ensonga ezo okuleetebwa ku lunaku olwo, ne zitereezebwa eyo ne zimalirizibwa; era nti olw’ekyo, abaweereza n’abantu baabwe basaanidde okusisinkana n’okulabika wamu mu maaso g’Omulamuzi omukulu ku lunaku olwo.

OKUSSA MU NKOLA

Engeri gye nandyagadde okukozesaamu ebintu ebyogeddwako, kwe kuleetera abantu abali wano ababadde wansi w’okulabirira kwange okw’obusumba okufumiitiriza ku bintu ebimu, n’okubawa okubuulirira okumu okusaanira embeera yaffe eya kaakano; okukwata ku ebyo ebikoleddwa gye buvuddeko okutwawula, ku nkolagana gye tubaddemu edda omu ku munne; naye nga tusuubira okusisinkana omu ku munne mu maaso g’entebe enkulu ey’okusalirako emisango ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango.

Okulowooza ennyo n’obwegendereza ku kusisinkana kwaffe okwo okugenda okujja okusinga obukulu mazima kwe kusinga okusaanira mu kiseera nga kino; nga gye buvuddeko waliwo ekyakoleddwa, ekiyinzika ennyo, (ku nkolagana gye tubaddemu edda) okuddirirwa okwawukana okutaggwaawo.

Nga tusisinkanye wamu emirundi emeka mu nnyumba ya Katonda mu nkolagana eno! Nga njogedde nammwe emirundi emeka, ne mbayigiriza, ne mbabuulirira, ne mbalabula, ne mbalungamya era ne mbaliisa, era ne ngaba amateeka ag’ekkanisa mu mmwe, ng’abantu abaakwasibwa okulabirira kwange, era ng’emmeeme zammwe ez’omuwendo nnali nzirabirira! Naye kiyinzika ennyo nti kino tekiriddamu kubaawo nate.

Nnabbi Yeremiya (essuula 25:3), ajjukiza abantu ebbanga lye yali amaze ng’ateganira mu bo mu mulimu gw’obuweereza: “Okuva mu mwaka ogw’ekkumi n’esatu ogw’obufuzi bwa Yosiya mutabani wa Amoni kabaka wa Yuda, gy’emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu okutuusa leero, ekigambo kya Mukama kizze gye ndi era njogedde gye muli, nga nzuukuka mu makya ne njogera.” Sigenda kwegeraageranya ne nnabbi Yeremiya; naye mu kino nsobola okwogera nga bwe yayogera, nti “Mbabuulidde ekigambo kya Katonda okumala emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu, nga nzuukuka mu makya ne njogera.” Emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu gyaweera, ku lunaku olw’ekkumi n’ettaano ogwa Febwali ewedde, okuva lwe nnatandika okutegana mu mulimu gw’obuweereza, mu nkolagana ey’omusumba eri ekkanisa eno n’ekibiina kino. Era newakubadde nga amaanyi gange gabadde bunafu, nga bulijjo nteganidde wansi w’obunafu bw’omubiri obunene, ng’oggyeeko obutasaanira bwange obw’omulimu omunene bwe gutyo mu ngeri endala, naye ssirekedde maanyi gange amanafu, wabula ngakozesezza olw’obulungi bw’emmeeme zammwe. Nsobola okubajulizaako nga omutume bw’ajuliza abawulize be, Abaggalatiya 4:13, “Mumanyi nga mu bunafu obw’omubiri, mmwe be nasooka okubuulira Enjiri.” Mmaze ekiseera ekisinga obulungi eky’obulamu bwange n’amaanyi gange mu kutegana olw’obulungi bwammwe obutaggwaawo. Muli bajulirwa bange, nti amaanyi ge mbadde nago sigalagajjalidde mu bugayaavu, so sigakozesezza mu kugoberera enteekateeka ez’ensi n’okuddukanya ensonga ez’ensi, olw’okukuza ebintu byange eby’ebweru, n’okwegulumiza nze n’amaka gange; wabula neewaddeyo ddala eri omulimu gw’obuweereza, nga nteganira mu gwo emisana n’ekiro, nga nzuukuka mu makya era nga nteeka omutima gwange ku mulimu guno omunene Kristo gwe yanteekamu. Nzudde omulimu gw’obuweereza mu mmwe nga mulimu munene ddala, omulimu ogw’okufaayo okungi ennyo, okutegana n’obuzibu: byabadde bingi ebizito bye nneetisse mu gwo, amaanyi gange bye gaabadde tegasobola bulungi. Katonda yampita okwetikka ebizito bino; era neebaza erinnya lye, nti yanwanirira bw’atyo okunkuuma obutabbira wansi waabyo, era nti amaanyi ge mu kino geeyolese mu bunafu bwange; ne kiba nti newakubadde nga emirundi mingi nnyigirizibwa erudda n’erudda, naye sibetentese; neeraliikirira, naye sizirise; nsuuliddwa wansi, naye sibetentuse.

Naye kaakano nnina ensonga okulowooza nti omulimu gwange gwe nnalina okukola ng’omuweereza wammwe guwedde: mungaanye mu lwatu, n’emikisa gyange gikomye.

N’olwekyo kaakano nga kitusaanidde nnyo okulowooza ku kiseera ekyo lwe kirituteekwa okusisinkana omu ku munne mu maaso g’Omusumba omukulu! Lwe kirinteekwa okubala embalirira ey’obuwanika bwange, ey’obuweereza bwe nkoze, n’engeri gye nnayanirizibwamu era gye nnakwatibwamu, mu bantu be yantumira: era nammwe kibagwanidde okubala embalirira ey’enneeyisa yammwe gye ndi, n’engeri gye mukozesezzaamu emyaka gino amakumi abiri mu esatu egy’obuweereza bwange. Kubanga mu kiseera ekyo mmwe nange kitugwanidde okulabika wamu, era ffembi kitugwanidde okubala embalirira, olw’okusalirwa omusango okutasobya, okw’obutuukirivu era okutaggwaawo oyo alitusalira omusango ku byonna bye twayogera oba bye twakola mu kusisinkana kwaffe wano, enneeyisa yaffe yonna omu eri munne, mu nnyumba ya Katonda ne mu bifo ebirala, ku Ssabbiiti ne ku nnaku endala; oyo alikebera emitima gyaffe n’ayolesa ebirowoozo byaffe, n’emisingi n’embeera z’emitima gyaffe, alitusalira omusango ku mpaka zonna ezaabaddewo wakati waffe, mu butasosola obusingayo, era alikebera engeri gye twakwatanamu omu ku munne mu mpaka ezo. Teri kyakisibwa ekitalibikkulwa, era tewali kyakwekebwa ekitalimanyibwa; byonna birikeberebwa mu kitangaala ekikebera era ekiyingira ennyo eky’okumanya byonna kwa Katonda n’ekitiibwa kye, n’oyo amaaso ge agali ng’ennimi z’omuliro; era amazima n’obutuufu birirabisibwa mu lwatu, nga biggiddwako buli kibikka; era ensobi yonna, obulimba, obutali butuukirivu n’okukola obubi biribikkulwa, nga biggiddwako buli kibikka; buli kyekwaso ekiwulikika obulungi, buli kwemulugunya n’empaka zonna ez’obulimba birigwaawo mu kaseera katono, nga tebisobola kugumira kitangaala kya lunaku olwo. Era mu kiseera ekyo emitima gyaffe girikyusibwa ne gissibwa ebweru, n’ebyama byagyo birirabisibwa mu lwatu okusinga ebikolwa byaffe eby’ebweru bwe birabika kaakano. Mu kiseera ekyo kirirabika ebigendererwa bye tubaddenga tutunuulira, emisingi egibadde gitufuga gye tubaddenga tukoleramu, n’embeera gye tubaddenga tulaga mu mpaka zaffe ez’ekkanisa n’okuyomba. Mu kiseera ekyo kirirabika oba nnakola mu bwesimbu, era olw’okufaayo okw’omuntu ow’omunda okwa ddala era okw’obwegendereza ku buvunaanyizibwa bwange eri Mukama wange omukulu era Mukama wange, mu mpaka ezimu ez’ekkanisa ez’edda, ezaabaddemu embeera n’ebivaamu eby’ennaku ennyo: kirirabika oba waaliwo ensonga yonna ey’obwenkanya olw’obusungu obwalagibwa ku mikolo egyo. Era mu kiseera ekyo empaka zaffe ennene ezaakayita, ku bisaanyizo ebyetaagisa okukkirizibwa mu birabo by’abammemba abajjuvu mu kkanisa ya Kristo erabika, zirikeberebwa era zirisalirwa omusango mu bitundu byazo byonna n’embeera zaazo, era byonna biriteekebwa mu kitangaala ekitangaavu, ekikakafu era ekituukiridde. Mu kiseera ekyo kirirabika oba enjigiriza gye mbuulidde era gye nfulumizza ku nsonga eno y’enjigiriza ya Kristo yennyini, oba taligikkiriza ng’emu ku mazima ag’omuwendo agavudde mu kamwa ke yennyini, n’agiwolereza era n’agissaamu ekitiibwa nga bw’eri mu maaso g’obutonde bwonna. Mu kiseera ekyo kirirabika ekitegeezebwa “omuntu ajja nga talina kyambalo kya mbaga”; kubanga olwo lwe lunaku olwogerwako, Matayo 22:13, omuntu ng’oyo lw’alisibibwa emikono n’amagulu, n’akasukibwa ebweru mu kizikiza, eri okukaaba n’okuluma obujiji. Era mu kiseera ekyo kirirabika oba, mu kulangirira enjigiriza eno, n’okukola nga bw’egamba, ne mu nneeyisa yange yonna mu nsonga eno, nnakwatibwako okufaayo kwonna ku byagalo byange eby’ensi oba ekitiibwa, oba okwegomba okulabika nga ndi mugezi okusinga abalala; oba nnakola olw’endowooza yonna embi, ey’ensi yonna; era oba ebyo bye nkoze tebyavudde mu kufaayo okw’obwegendereza, okukakafu era okw’obukkakkamu ku kwagala kwa Mukama wange era Mukama wange, era kubanga sigumanga kumunyiiza, nga ndi mumativu ku kwagala kwe kye kyali, oluvannyuma lw’okunoonyereza okw’ebbanga eddene, okw’obunyiikivu, okutasosola era okw’okusaba; nga kino nkirina bulijjo mu maaso gange okunneetaaza okwegendereza ennyo obutasalawo mu bwangu nti amazima gali ku ludda luno olw’ensonga, kwe nkakasiddwa kaakano nti gye gali, nti okusalawo okwo tekwandibadde kwa magoba gange ag’ensi, wabula kwandigakontanye mu buli ngeri, ne kundeetera omuddiring’anwa omuwanvu ogw’ebizibu ebinene ennyo era ne kunsuula mu bunnya obw’ebizibu n’ennaku. Era mu kiseera ekyo kirirabika oba abantu bange bakoze obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe eri omusumba waabwe ku nsonga eno; oba balaze embeera n’omwoyo ebituufu ku mukolo guno; oba bankoledde obwenkanya mu kuwulira, mu kussaayo omwoyo n’okulowooza ku ebyo bye nnalina okwogera ng’obukakafu bw’ebyo bye nnakkiriza era bye nnayigiriza ng’ekitundu ky’okuteesa kwa Katonda; oba nkwatiddwa n’obutasosola, omutima omulongoofu n’okufaayo Omulamuzi omwenkanya bye yalaba nga binsaanira; era oba, mu bikolwa bingi ebikoleddwa n’ebintu bingi ebyogeddwa n’ebikoleddwa mu kutambula kw’empaka zino, obutuukirivu n’okwagala n’empisa ennungi ez’Ekikristaayo bikuumiddwa; oba, bwe kiba nga si bwe kityo, ebintu bino bimenyeddwa ku ddaala ki. Mu kiseera ekyo buli kikolwa eky’enneeyisa ya buli omu ku ffe mu nsonga eno, okuva ku lubereberye okutuuka ku nkomerero, n’omwoyo gwe twalaga mu byonna birikeberebwa era birirabisibwa, era emyoyo gyaffe egy’omunda girinyumya mu lwatu era mu ddoboozi ddene, era buli omu ku ffe alikakasibwa, n’ensi erimanya; era tewaliddamu kubaawo nate nsobi, kunnyonnyola bubi oba kutegeera bubi ku nsonga eno emirembe n’emirembe.

Empaka zino kaakano kiyinzika nti zituusiddwa ku nkomerero wakati wammwe nange ku bikwata ku nsi eno; zaakoma mu ekyo ekyabaawo mu wiiki eyasooka ku ewedde: naye kizigwanidde okusalibwawo omulundi omulala ku lunaku olwo olukulu, olujja okutuuka mazima, mmwe nange lwe tulisisinkana wamu mu maaso g’entebe enkulu ey’okusalirako emisango: era n’olwekyo nzireka okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo, era sijja kwongera kuzoogerako kaakano.

Naye kaakano nandyagadde okweyongerayo okwogera mu ngeri ey’enjawulo eri abantu ab’engeri ez’enjawulo.

I. Eri abo abeeyatula okutya Katonda mu ffe.

Kaakano nandyagadde okubakoowoola okulowooza ennyo ku lunaku olwo olukulu lwe kirikugwanira okusisinkana oyo abadde omusumba wammwe edda, mu maaso g’Omulamuzi amaaso ge agali ng’ennimi z’omuliro.

Ngezezzaako, okusinziira ku busobozi bwange bwonna, okunoonya mu kigambo kya Katonda, ku bubonero obwawula okutya Katonda okwa ddala, obwo abantu bwe bayinza okusinga okuzuulamu embeera yaabwe, n’okwesalira omusango mu ngeri esinga obukakafu n’obutangaavu. Era amateeka gano n’obubonero buno mbisizza ku mmwe emirundi n’emirundi mu kubuulira ekigambo okusinziira ku bukugu bwange bwonna, era mu ngeri esinga obwangu n’okukebera gye nsobodde, okusobola okuzuula omunnanfuusi alimbiddwa n’okunyweza essuubi n’okubudaabudibwa kw’ab’amazima. Naye kityibwa nti, oluvannyuma lw’ebyo byonna bye nkoze, kaakano ndeka abamu ku mmwe mu mbeera ey’okulimbibwa era ey’okubuzibwa; kubanga tekisaanidde kulowooza nti mu beeyatuzi ebikumi n’ebikumi, tewali n’omu alimbiddwa.

Okuva kaakano kirabika sijja kuddamu kufuna mukisa okulabirira n’okukuuma emmeeme zammwe, okuzikebera n’okuzinoonyaamu. Naye nkyabeegayirira okujjukira n’okulowooza ku mateeka ge nnabateerangawo emirundi mingi mu buweereza bwange, nga mufaayo nnyo ku lunaku olujja mmwe nange lwe kirituteekwa okusisinkana wamu mu maaso g’Omulamuzi waffe; amagezi ag’okwekebera ge mwawulira okuva gye ndi lwe galiddibwamu nate mu maaso gammwe, n’amateeka ago ag’okugezesa lwe galigezesebwa, era kirirabika oba gabadde malungi oba nedda; era kirirabika n’oba mwagawulira awatali kusosola, ne mwegezesa nago; era Omulamuzi yennyini, atasobya, aligezesa mmwe nange: era oluvannyuma lw’ekyo tewaliba alimbibwa ku mbeera y’emmeeme ye.

Emirundi mingi mbajjukiza nti, ne bwe mwandibadde mwekwasa obumanyirivu, okubikkulirwa, okubudaabudibwa n’essanyu bwe biti, ku lunaku olwo buli muntu alisalirwa omusango ng’ebikolwa bye bwe biri; era mu kiseera ekyo mulikisanga bwe kiri.

Mufune omuweereza ow’okumanya okusingawo okw’ekigambo kya Katonda n’okutegeera okusingawo okw’ensonga z’emmeeme, era ow’obukugu obusingawo mu kwetereeza eri emmeeme, okwogera kwe kuyinza okusinga okukebera n’okukakasa; abo ku mmwe abaanywerera ku bulimba wansi w’okubuulira kwange, amaaso gaabwe gaggulwe olw’okubuulira kwe; mulyoke muggibwe mu bulimba ng’olunaku olwo olukulu terunnatuuka.

Amakubo n’obuyambi obw’okuyigirizibwa n’okwekebera bye muyinza okufuna oluvannyuma tebimanyiddwa; naye ekintu kimu kikakafu, nti ekiseera kitono, omukisa gwammwe ogw’okutereeza ensobi mu nsonga enkulu bw’etyo gujja kukoma mangu. Tuli mu nsi ey’enkyukakyuka ennene. Kaakano wazzeewo enkyukakyuka ennene; mwevudde mu buweereza bwange bwe mubaddemu okumala emyaka emingi bwe gityo: naye ekiseera kijja, era kijja kutuuka mangu, lwe muliva mu biseera ne muyingira mu mirembe egitaggwaawo; era bwe mutyo muliva wansi w’amakubo gonna ag’ekisa.

Abasinga obungi ku mmwe abeeyatula okutya Katonda (okukozesa ekigambo ky’omutume) “mwamanyako ekitundu” nti ndi wammwe: edda mwakkiriza nti ndi kitammwe ow’omwoyo, ekikozesebwa eky’obulungi obusinga obunene gye muli obwali bufunye oba obuyinza okufunibwa omuntu yenna ku baana b’abantu. Mulowooze ku lunaku olwo mmwe nange lwe tulisisinkana mu maaso g’Omulamuzi waffe, lwe kirikeberebwa oba mwafuna gye ndi okukwatibwa okusaanira abaana ab’omwoyo, era oba mwankwata nga bwe mwali musaanidde okukwata kitammwe ow’omwoyo. Ng’enkolagana ey’omuzadde ow’omubiri bw’eteeka obuvunaanyizibwa obunene ku baana mu maaso ga Katonda; bwe kityo okusingawo ennyo, mu ngeri nnyingi, enkolagana ey’omuzadde ow’omwoyo bw’eteeka obuvunaanyizibwa obunene ku abo be balowooza nti Katonda yabafuula ekikozesebwa eky’okukyuka kwabwe n’obulokozi bwabwe obutaggwaawo: 1 Abakkolinso 4:15, “Kubanga newaakubadde mulina abalala nkumi na nkumi ababayigiriza ebya Kristo, naye mujjukirenga nga mulina bakitammwe batono. Kubanga nze mbazaala mu Kristo olw’enjiri.”

II. Kaakano nga nsiibula abantu bano nandyagadde okwogera eri abo mu bo be ndeka mu mbeera etaliimu Kristo era etaliimu kisa; era nandyagadde okukoowoola abo okulowooza ennyo ku lunaku olwo olw’ekitiibwa bo nange lwe kirituteekwa okusisinkana mu maaso g’Omulamuzi w’ensi.

Okwawukana kwange nammwe mu ngeri ezimu kwa nnaku mu ngeri ey’enjawulo; kubanga mbaleka mu mbeera esinga obunaku; kubanga mbaleka mu kukaawa kw’obusungu n’enjegere z’obutali butuukirivu, nga obusungu bwa Katonda bubabeeraako, era nga mukyali wansi w’okusalirwa omusango okw’obunaku obutaggwaawo n’okuzikirira. Nga bwe kingwanidde okubaleka, kyandibadde kya kubudaabuda era kya ssanyu mu kwawukana kwaffe singa nnabaleka mu Kristo, nga muli bakuume era ba mukisa mu kiddukiro ekyo ekikakafu n’ekiwummulo eky’ekitiibwa eky’abatukuvu. Naye si bwe kiri. Mbaleka nga muli wala, nga muli bannamawanga era abagenyi, abafugibwa ab’ennaku era abasibe b’ekibi ne Setaani era abasibe b’obwenkanya obuwoolera eggwanga; nga temulina Kristo era nga temulina Katonda mu nsi.

Emyoyo gyammwe egy’omunda gimpa obujulirwa, nti bwe nnali nkyalina omukisa, ssirekanga kubalabula n’okubateeka mu maaso akabi kammwe. Nfubye okulaga obunaku n’obwetaavu bw’embeera yammwe mu ngeri esinga obutangaavu. Ngezezzaako amakubo gonna ge nsobodde okulowooza agaali gayinza okuzuukusa emyoyo gyammwe egy’omunda, n’okubategeeza obwetaavu bw’okukozesa obulungi ekiseera kyammwe, n’okwanguwa okudduka obusungu obujja n’okunyiikira mu kukozesa amakubo ag’okuwona kwammwe n’obukuumi bwammwe. Nfubye n’obunyiikivu okunoonya n’okukozesa ensonga ezisinga amaanyi okubasendasenda okufaayo ku bulungi bwammwe n’obulokozi bwammwe. Sifubye kubazuukusa kyokka, mulyoke mukwatibwe okutya, wabula nkozesezza amaanyi gange gonna okubawangula: nnoonyezza ebigambo ebisanyusa, bwe kiba kisoboka mbasendesende okuleka ekibi, n’okukyukira Katonda, n’okukkiriza Kristo ng’Omulokozi wammwe era Mukama wammwe. Ngakozesezza nnyo amaanyi gange mu bintu bino. Naye, ku mmwe be njogera nabo kaakano, sisobodde kuwangula: naye leero nnina ensonga okwemulugunya mu bigambo bino, Yeremiya 6:29: “Emivubo bagifukuta n’amaanyi, omuliro gumalawo essasi, naye balongoosereza bwereere kubanga ababi tebaggyibwamu.” Kityibwa nti emirimu gyange gyonna, eri bangi ku mmwe, tegirina kirala kye gikoze wabula okubakakanyaza; era nti ekigambo kye mbuulidde, mu kifo ky’okuba akawoowo ak’obulamu akatuusa mu bulamu, kibadde akawoowo ak’okufa akatuusa mu kufa. Newakubadde nga sigenda kubala mbalirira mu biseera ebijja ku abo abagaanye obuweereza bwange mu lwatu era mu kumalirira, ng’ekintu ekyankwasibwa: naye mujjukire nti kibagwanidde okwebalira mmwe bennyini embalirira ey’okufaayo kwammwe ku mmeeme zammwe, n’engeri gye mukozesezzaamu amakubo gonna agayise n’agagenda okujja, mu bulamu bwammwe bwonna. Katonda yekka y’amanyi ekiriba ku mmeeme zammwe ennaku ezizikirira, amakubo ki ge muyinza okufuna oluvannyuma, oba ebizibu n’okugezesebwa ki bye muyinza okubaamu. Katonda mu kusaasira kwe abawe nti, newakubadde nga amakubo gonna agayise tegaavaamu kantu, mufune amakubo mu biseera ebijja agaliba n’ekiva mu go ekiggya; era nti ekigambo kya Katonda, nga bwe kiribagabirwa oluvannyuma, kibeere ng’omuliro n’ennyondo eyasaayasa olwazi. Naye, ka mbakubirize kaakano nga twawukana era mbeegayirire obutayabulira ddala kulabula kwe mwafuna nga muli wansi w’obuweereza bwange. Mmwe nange bwe tulisisinkana ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango, mu kiseera ekyo mulikujjukira: okundaba, omuweereza wammwe ow’edda, ku mukolo ogwo, kujja kukuzuukiza mangu mu birowoozo byammwe; era ekyo mu ngeri ekwata ennyo ku mutima. Ayi, ekyo kireme kuba kiseera kisooka kwe kizuukiziddwa bwe kityo.

Mmwe nange kaakano twawukana omu ku munne ku bikwata ku nsi eno; ka tufube tuleme kwawukana oluvannyuma lw’okusisinkana kwaffe ku lunaku olusembayo. Bwe mba nga mbadde omusumba wammwe omwesigwa (ekirirabika ku lunaku olwo, oba bwe kiri oba nedda), mu kiseera ekyo ndyejjeerezebwa, era ndirinnya ne Kristo. Ayi mukole ekitundu kyammwe, mu mbeera eyo kireme kubeera bwe kityo, nti mukakibwa okwawukana nange emirembe gyonna n’abo bonna ababadde abeesigwa mu Kristo Yesu. Kuno kwawukana kwa nnaku okuliwo kaakano wakati wammwe nange, naye okwo kwandibadde kwawukana kwa nnaku nnyo gye muli okusinga kuno. Kuno muyinza oboolyawo okukugumira nga temukwatiddwako nnyo, bwe muba nga temukusanyukidde; naye okwawukana ng’okwo ku lunaku olwo kujja kubakwatako mu ngeri esinga obuziba, ey’okuwulira, era ey’entiisa.

III. Nandyagadde okwogera eri abo abali mu kuzuukusibwa okumu.

Katonda yeebazibwe nti waliwo abali bwe batyo, era nti (newakubadde nga nnina ensonga okutya nti ndeka bangi nnyo mu kibiina kino ekinene mu mbeera etaliimu Kristo) naye sibaleka bonna mu kukakanyala kwonna n’obutafaayo ku mmeeme zaabwe. Abamu ku mmwe be nnina ensonga okusuubira nti bali mu kuzuukusibwa okumu, bambuulidde embeera zammwe; ekiyinza okundeetera, kaakano nga mbaleka, okubasiibula nga nfaayo ku mmwe mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Ekiriva mu kulwana kw’omutima gwammwe okwa kaakano sikimanyi: naye kirimanyibwa ku lunaku olwo, mmwe nange lwe tulisisinkana mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako emisango. N’olwekyo kaakano mulowooze nnyo ku lunaku olwo.

Kaakano nga nnawukana n’ekisibo kino, nandyagadde omulundi omulala okubakubiriza okubuulirira kwe nnabawa edda, okwegendereza obutalagajjala mu nsonga enkulu bw’etyo, okunyiikira n’okuba ab’amazima mu nsonga eno, n’okwegendereza okudda emabega, okunywerera n’okugumiikiriza okutuuka ku nkomerero. Era mukaabire Katonda n’amaanyi, enkyukakyuka zino ennene eziyita ku kkanisa eno n’ekibiina kino zireme kubeera kugwa kwammwe. Mu zo mulimu okugezesebwa okunene; era Setaani awatali kubuusabuusa ajja kunoonya okuzeeyambisa, bwe kiba kisoboka okuleetera okukakasibwa kwammwe okwa kaakano n’okufuba kwammwe okufa nga tebinnaba kubala bibala. Kibeetaagisa okwongera obunyiikivu bwammwe emirundi ebiri, n’okutunula n’okusaba, mulemenga kuwangulwa kugezesebwa.

Ne bw’alibeera ani alibeera n’enkolagana nammwe oluvannyuma ng’omulungamya wammwe ow’omwoyo, okwagala kwange n’okusaba kwange kwe kuno, nti Omusumba omukulu ow’endiga abafeeko mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, era abeere omulungamya wammwe (kubanga tewali ayigiriza nga ye), era nti oyo, ensulo etaliiko kkomo ey’ekitangaala, “abazibule amaaso gammwe, mukyuke muve mu kizikiza mudde eri omusana, n’okuva mu buyinza bwa Setaani, mudde eri Katonda, mulyoke musonyiyibwe ebibi, mufune omugabo wamu n’abo abatukuzibwa olw’okukkiriza okuli mu Kristo;” bwe kityo, ku lunaku olwo olukulu, bwe ndibasisinkana nate mu maaso g’Omulamuzi wammwe era owange, tulyoke tusisinkane mu mbeera ey’essanyu era ey’ekitiibwa, obutaddamu kwawukana nate.

IV. Nandyagadde okwogera eri abavubuka ab’ekibiina.

Okuva lwe nnateekebwa mu mulimu gw’obuweereza mu kifo kino bulijjo mbadde nfaayo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku mmeeme z’abavubuka, era nga njagala eddiini ekulaakulane mu bo: era nfubye nnyo okutuuka ku kino; kubanga nnali mmanyi omukisa ogw’enjawulo gwe baalina okusinga abalala, era nti ebiseera ebisinga abo Katonda be yali agenderera okusaasira, baaleetebwanga okumutya n’okumwagala mu buvubuka bwabwe. Era bulijjo kirabise gye ndi nga kintu kya kwagalibwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, okulaba abavubuka nga batambulira mu makubo g’empisa ennungi n’okutya Katonda okw’Ekikristaayo, nga emitima gyabwe girongooseddwa era nga giwoomezeddwa n’omusingi gw’okwagala okw’obwakatonda. Era kirabise nga kintu kirungi nnyo ddala, era ekyandiyonjezza ennyo n’okusanyusa ekibuga, singa abavubuka bandisendeddwasendeddwa bwe basisinkana wamu, okunyumya ng’Abakristaayo, era ng’abaana ba Katonda; nga beewala obugwagwa, eby’obusirusiru n’okweyisa obubi; nga banywerera ddala ku mateeka g’empisa ennungi, era nga banyumya wamu ku bintu bya Katonda ne Kristo n’eggulu. Kino kye mbadde neegomba: era kibadde kinnakuwaza nnyo bwe mbadde mpulira ku bubi, obutaliimu n’obutali butebenkevu mu bavubuka baffe. Era nga bwe mmanyi omutima gwange, kyava wano edda lwe nnakulembera ekkanisa eno okukola ebimu okuziyiza obubi mu bavubuka baffe, ebyanyiiza ennyo bwe bityo, era olw’ebyo ne nfuuka omukyayibwa bwe ntyo. Nnoonyezza obulungi, so si kabi, bw’abavubuka baffe. Nnyagadde ekitiibwa kyabwe eky’amazima n’essanyu lyabwe, so si kuvumibwa kwabwe; nga mmanyi nti empisa ennungi ey’amazima n’eddiini tebiretera bavubuka kitiibwa n’essanyu mu nsi endala kyokka, wabula n’emirembe gyabwe egisingayo n’okukulaakulana, n’obukulu bwabwe obusingayo n’ekitiibwa, mu nsi eno; era okusinga byonna okuwoomya n’okufuula ennaku ez’obuvubuka zennyini ez’essanyu era ez’okwesiima.

Naye oba mbaagadde era nga nnoonyeza obulungi bwammwe nnyo oba kitono, naye Katonda mu bulabirizi bwe kaakano bw’ampita okwawukana nammwe, nga nkwasa emmeeme zammwe oyo eyali ankwasizza edda okuzirabirira ng’omusumba, tewali kisigaddeyo wabula (nga kaakano bwe mbasiibula) okubeegayirira n’amaanyi, olw’okwagala kwe mwerina, bwe muba nga temunjagala, obutanyooma era obutayabulira kulabula n’okubuulirira kwe mbawadde emirundi mingi bwe gityo; nga mujjukira olunaku mmwe nange lwe kirituteekwa okusisinkana nate mu maaso g’Omulamuzi omukulu ow’abalamu n’abafu; lwe kirirabika oba ebintu bye nnabayigiriza byali bya mazima, oba okubuulirira kwe nnabawa kwali kulungi, era oba nnanoonyanga ddala obulungi bwammwe, era oba mwakozesa bulungi okufuba kwange.

Emirundi n’emirundi mbalabudde n’amaanyi ku kuzannya okw’obwereere (nga bwe kuyitibwa), n’eddembe eddala abavubuka lye batera okwetwalira mu nsi. Era ne bwe wabaawo abamu aboogera bye boogera okuwolereza eddembe eryo n’empisa ezo, era ne basekerera okulabula okubiwakanya, kaakano mbaleka obujulirwa bwange obw’okusiibula obuwakanya ebintu ng’ebyo; nga sibuusabuusa nti Katonda alibusiima era alibunyweza ku lunaku olwo lwe tulisisinkana mu maaso ge.

V. Nandyagadde okwogera eri abaana ab’ekibiina, abaana b’endiga ab’ekisibo kino, ababadde wansi w’okulabirira kwange ebbanga eddene bwe lityo.

Nnaakamala okwogera nti mbadde nfaayo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku bavubuka; era bwe nnayogera bwe ntyo saagenderera kubaggyamu mmwe. Muli mu buvubuka, era mu buvubuka obusooka ennyo: era n’olwekyo mbadde mmanyi nti abo abaali abato bwe baalina omukisa ogw’omuwendo olw’obulungi bw’emmeeme zaabwe, mmwe abato ennyo mwalina, mu ngeri nnyingi, omukisa ogw’omuwendo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Era bwe ntyo sibalagajjalidde: ngezezzaako okukola ekitundu ky’omusumba omwesigwa, mu kuliisa abaana b’endiga wamu n’endiga. Kristo yankwasa edda okulabirira emmeeme zammwe ng’omuweereza wammwe; era mumanyi, abaana abaagalwa, nga bwe mbayigirizza, era nga bwe mbalabudde emirundi n’emirundi; mumanyi nga bwe mbayise emirundi mingi okukuŋŋaana olw’ekigendererwa ekyo; era abamu ku mmwe, oluusi, mulabise nga mukwatiddwako ebyo bye nnabagamba. Naye ntya nti tebiryaleese kirungi kya bulokozi eri bangi ku mmwe; wabula nti mukyasigadde mu mbeera etali nkyuke, awatali mulimu gwa bulokozi ogwa ddala ogukoleddwa mu mmeeme zammwe, ogubakakasa ddala ekibi kyammwe n’obunaku bwammwe, ogubaleetera okulaba obubi obunene obw’ekibi, n’okukikungubagira, n’okukikyawa okusinga ebintu byonna, era ogubawa okutegeera obulungi obw’ekitalo obwa Mukama Yesu Kristo, ogubaleeta n’emitima gyammwe gyonna okumwekwatako ng’Omulokozi wammwe, ogwawula emitima gyammwe ku nsi, era ogubaleetera okwagala Katonda okusinga byonna, n’okusanyukira obutukuvu okusinga ebintu byonna ebisanyusa eby’ensi eno; era bwe kityo nti kaakano mbaleka mu mbeera ey’ennaku, nga temulina mugabo mu Kristo, era bwe kityo nga muli wansi w’obutasiima obw’entiisa n’obusungu bwa Katonda, era mu kabi k’okukka mu kinnya eky’obunaku obutaggwaawo.

Naye kaakano kiŋŋwanidde okubasiibula: kiŋŋwanidde okubaleka mu mikono gya Katonda; sisobola kubakolera kirala kyonna okuggyako okubasabira. Kyokka mbegayirira obutayabulira, wabula okulowoozanga emirundi mingi ku kubuulirira n’okulabula kwe nnabawa, n’okufuba kwe nnakozesa, emmeeme zammwe zirokolebwe okuva mu kuzikirira okutaggwaawo.

Abaana abaagalwa, mbaleka mu nsi embi, ejjudde emitego n’okugezesebwa. Katonda yekka y’amanyi ekiriba ku mmwe. Kino Ebyawandiikibwa bitubuulidde, nti abalokolebwa batono; era tulina obukakafu bungi obw’ekyo mu bye tulaba. Kino tukiraba, nti abaana bafa ng’abalala: bangi nnyo bafa nga tebannakula; era ku abo abakula, batono nnyo bw’ogeraageranya abalaga obukakafu obulungi obw’okukyuka okw’obulokozi okudda eri Katonda. Nsaba Katonda abasaasire, era abalabirire, era abawe amakubo agasinga obulungi olw’obulungi bw’emmeeme zammwe; era nti Katonda yennyini yeetwalire okubeera Kitammwe ow’omu ggulu era Omununuzi ow’amaanyi ow’emmeeme zammwe ezitafa. Temulagajjalanga kwesabira: mwegenderezenga muleme kubeera mu muwendo gw’abo abasuula eri okutya era abaziyiza okusaba mu maaso ga Katonda. Musabenga Katonda bulijjo mu kyama; era mujjukirenga emirundi mingi olunaku olwo olukulu lwe kiribagwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako emisango, ne musisinkana eyo omuweereza wammwe, eyababuulirira era n’abalabula emirundi mingi bwe gityo.

Nkomekkereza n’ebigambo bitono eby’okubuulirira eri bonna okutwalira awamu, mu nsonga ezimu, ezikulu ennyo olw’obulungi n’okukulaakulana kw’ekkanisa eno n’ekibiina kino.

1. Ekintu kimu ekibakwatako ennyo, nga bwe mwandyagadde okuba abantu abasanyufu, kwe kukuuma entegeka ennungi mu maka.

Tubadde n’empaka ennene ku ngeri ekkanisa gy’esaanidde okutegekebwamu; era mazima omulamwa gw’empaka zino gwali gwa bukulu bunene: naye okutegeka obulungi amaka gammwe si kwa bukulu butono, era, mu ngeri ezimu, kwa bukulu bunene nnyo okusingawo. Buli maka ag’Ekikristaayo gasaanidde okuba, ng’olubeerera, ekkanisa entono, eyawuliddwa eri Kristo, era efugibwa era erungamizibwa ddala amateeka ge. Era okuyigiriza mu maka n’entegeka ennungi bye bimu ku makubo ag’ekisa agasinga obukulu. Bino bwe bigwa, amakubo amalala gonna kirabika tegajja kuvaamu kantu. Bino bwe bikuumibwa obulungi, amakubo gonna ag’ekisa kirabika gajja kukulaakulana era gavemu ebirungi.

N’olwekyo ka mmale kaakano, omulundi omulala, nga sinnalekera ddala kwogera eri ekibiina kino, okuddamu n’okukubiriza n’amaanyi okubuulirira kwe nnakubirizanga emirundi mingi abakulu b’amaka wano, bwe nnali omusumba waabwe, okufuba ennyo mu kuyigiriza, okulabula n’okulungamya abaana baabwe; nga babakuza nga babagunjula era nga babayigiriza ebya Mukama waffe; nga batandika mangu, awakyali omukisa, era nga bakuuma obunyiikivu obutakyuka mu mirimu egy’engeri eno; nga bajjukira nti, nga bwe mutandyagadde kuyigiriza kwammwe kwonna n’okubuulirira okuba okw’obwereere, kiteekwa okubaawo okufuga wamu n’okuyigiriza, okuteekwa okukuumibwa n’omukono ogwenkanya n’okumalirira okunywevu, ng’omukuumi w’eddiini n’empisa z’amaka n’ekiwanirira entegeka yaago ennungi. Mwegendereze kireme kubeera eri omu ku mmwe nga bwe kyali eri Eri ow’edda, eyanenya abaana be naye n’atabaziyiza; era nti, olw’ekyo, muleme kuleeta kikolimo kye kimu ku maka gammwe nga ye bwe yakireeta ku ge.

Era abaana bagonderenga bazadde baabwe, bakkirize okuyigiriza kwabwe, era bagondere ebiragiro byabwe, nga bwe bandyagadde okusikira omukisa so si kikolimo. Kubanga tulina ensonga okulowooza, olw’ebintu bingi mu kigambo kya Katonda, nti tewali kintu kisinga kuleeta kikolimo ku bantu mu nsi eno, ne ku nsonga zaabwe zonna ez’ensi, okusinga enneeyisa y’abaana etali ya buwulize, etali ya kugonda, era etali nteefu eri bazadde baabwe.

2. Nga bwe mwandinoonyezza okukulaakulana kw’ekibiina kino mu biseera ebijja, kya bukulu nnyo okwewala okuyomba.

Abantu abayombi baliba bantu ba nnaku. Okuyomba okubaddewo mu mmwe, okuva lwe nnasooka okufuuka omusumba wammwe, kubadde kimu ku bizito ebisinga obunene bye nneetisse mu kutambula kw’obuweereza bwange: si kuyomba kwe mubadde nakwo nange kwokka, wabula n’okwo kwe mubadde nakwo omu ku munne ku ttaka lyammwe n’ensonga endala: kubanga nnali mmanyi nti okuyomba, ebbugumu ly’omwoyo, okwogera obubi, n’ebintu eby’engeri eyo, bikontana butereevu n’omwoyo gw’Ekikristaayo, era bigoba, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, Omwoyo wa Katonda okuva mu bantu ne bifuula amakubo gonna ag’ekisa ag’obwereere, era ne bizikiriza n’okubudaabudibwa kw’abantu okw’ebweru n’obulungi bwabwe.

N’olwekyo ka mbakubirize n’amaanyi, nga bwe mwandinoonyezza obulungi bwammwe mu biseera ebijja, okwekuuma omwoyo ogw’okuyomba. Bwe muba mwagala okulaba ennaku ennungi, munoonyenga emirembe era mugigobererenga, 1 Peetero 3:10, 11. Okuyomba okubaddewo gye buvuddeko ku bisaanyizo by’okussa ekimu okw’Ekikristaayo, nga bwe kubadde okusinga obunene mu kuyomba kwammwe, kubeere n’okusembayo. Nandyagadde, kaakano nga mbuulira obubaka bwange obw’okusiibula, okubagamba, ng’Omutume bwe yagamba Abakkolinso, 2 Abakkolinso 13:11, 12: “Ebisigadde abooluganda, mweraba. Mutuukirire, mulowooze bumu, mubeere n’emirembe; Katonda ow’okwagala n’emirembe anaabeeranga nammwe.”

Era wano nandyagadde okubuulirira mu ngeri ey’enjawulo abo abannywereddeko mu mpaka ezaakayita, okukuuma emyoyo gyabwe n’okwewala obukaawu bwonna eri abalala. Okugezesebwa kwammwe, mu ngeri ezimu, kwe kusinga obunene; kubanga ebyakoleddwa gye buvuddeko bibanakuwaza. Naye ne bwe mulowooza nti abalala bakoze bubi batya, mukuume, n’obunyiikivu obunene n’okutunula, obuwombeefu obw’Ekikristaayo n’obukkakkamu bw’omwoyo; era mufube, mu kino, okusinga abalala abali ku ludda olulala. Era kino kye kiriba obuwanguzi obusinga obulungi: kubanga “oyo afuga omwoyo gwe akira awamba ekibuga.” N’olwekyo temukolanga kintu na kimu olw’okuvuganya wadde okwewaana okutaliimu. Temukkirizanga mwoyo gwa kuwoolera ggwanga mu ngeri yonna; wabula mukuumenga era musabenga okuguwakanya; era, mu makubo gonna ge musobola, munoonye okukulaakulana kw’ekibuga: era temulowoozanga nti mweyisa nga bwe kisaanira Abakristaayo, okuggyako nga mwagala abantu bonna mu mazima, mu kuwulira era n’ebbugumu, ab’ekibiina kyonna oba ab’endowooza yonna, era ne bwe baba ab’omukwano oba abatali ba kisa, abenkanya oba abakola obubi, gye muli oba eri mikwano gyammwe, oba eri ensonga n’obwakabaka bwa Kristo.

3. Ekintu ekirala ekikwata ennyo ku kukulaakulana kw’ekibuga kino mu biseera ebijja, kwe kuba nti mwekuuma okuyingirira kw’ensobi; naddala enjigiriza ya Arminius n’enjigiriza ezirina ekigendererwa ekifaanana.

Mwali, bangi ku mmwe, nga bwe nzijukira obulungi, abaatiisibwa ennyo olw’okulowooza ku kabi k’okubuna kw’emisingi gino egyoonoonese kumpi emyaka kkumi na mukaaga egiyise. Naye akabi mu kiseera ekyo kaali katono bw’ogeraageranya n’ekyo ekirabika kaakano. Enjigiriza zino leero zibunye nnyo okusinga bwe zaali mu kiseera ekyo: okweyongerayo kwe zikoze mu nsi, mu myaka gino omusanvu, kirabika kubadde kunene nnyo okusinga mu kiseera kyonna eky’ebbanga eryenkana awo emabega: era zikyabuna era zikyayingirira kumpi mu bitundu byonna eby’ensi, nga ziteeka mu kabi okuzikirira ddala kw’okussibwamu ekitiibwa kw’enjigiriza ezo ze kitiibwa eky’enjawulo eky’enjiri, n’obulungi bw’okutya Katonda okulamu. Era gye buvuddeko ndabye ebintu ebimu mu mmwe bennyini ebiraga nti muli wala nnyo okuba ebweru w’akabi, wabula ku ludda olulala muli mu kabi mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Abantu abakulu oboolyawo bayinza okulowooza nti beekuumye ekimala okuva mu kusiigibwa; naye kisaanidde bonna okwegendereza okwekakasa n’obukuumi obw’omubiri, era okujjukira okulabula okwo okwetaagisa okw’ebyawandiikibwa ebitukuvu, “Teweenyumirizanga, naye otyanga;” era “alowooza ng’ayimiridde, yeekuumenga aleme okugwa.” Naye embeera y’abantu abakulu k’ebeere nga bw’eri, omulembe ogukula awatali kubuusabuusa guli mu kabi nnyo. Emisingi gino gisikiriza nnyo obutonde obwoonoonese, era abavubuka, waakiri abo abatalina mitima gyabwe eminywevu mu kisa, basendebwasendebwa mangu nagyo.

Era emisingi gino singa gibuna nnyo mu kibuga kino, nga gye buvuddeko ennyo bwe gizze gikola mu kibuga ekirala ekinene kye nsobola okulonnya, ekyali edda kimanyiddwa nnyo olw’eddiini, era okumala ebbanga ddene, kijja kuteeka mu kabi okuzikirira okw’omwoyo era okutaggwaawo okw’abantu bano mu mulembe guno ne mu gigenda okujja. N’olwekyo mwetaaga okufaayo n’okutunula okusingayo era okw’obunyiikivu ennyo ku nsonga eno.

4. Ekintu ekirala kye nandibabuulidde, mulyoke mubeere abantu abakulaakulana mu biseera ebijja, kwe kuba nti mwewaayo nnyo mu kusaba.

Katonda ye nsulo y’omukisa gwonna n’okukulaakulana, era ayagala okunoonyezebwa olw’omukisa gwe. N’olwekyo nandibabuulidde obutakoma ku kunywerera mu kusaba okw’omu kyama n’okw’omu maka, ne mu kusinza Katonda okw’olwatu mu nnyumba ye, wabula n’okukuŋŋaananga emirundi mingi mu bibiina ebitono eby’okusaba. Nandibabuulidde bonna abanakuwala olw’okubonaabona kwa Yusufu, era abakwatiddwako nnyo ebibonyoobonyo by’ekibuga kino, ne bwe baba ab’endowooza ki ku mulamwa gw’empaka zaffe ezaakayita, okusisinkananga wamu emirundi mingi olw’okusaba, n’okukaabirira Katonda olw’okusaasira kwe gye bali, n’okusaasira eri ekibuga kino, n’okusaasira eri Sayuuni n’abantu ba Katonda okutwalira awamu mu nsi yonna.

5. Ekisembayo ku kubuulirira kwe nandibawadde (ekikwata ennyo ddala awatali kubuusabuusa ku kukulaakulana kwammwe), kwe kuba nti mufaayo nnyo ku kulonda omuweereza, okwetegereza ani, oba muntu wa ngeri ki gwe mussaawo; naddala mu ngeri zino ebbiri:

(1) Abeere muntu ow’emisingi emirungi ddala mu nteekateeka y’enjigiriza gy’akuuma.

Kino mujja kukyetaaga nnyo okusinga byonna, naddala mu biseera eby’obwonoonefu nga bino. Era okusobola okufuna omuntu ng’oyo, kibeetaagisa okufaayo n’okwegendereza okw’enjawulo. Mmanyi akabi. Mmanyi empisa z’abaami abavubuka bangi ab’emisingi egyoonoonese, engeri zaabwe ez’okwekweka, ebibikka eby’endabika ennungi era ebiwulikika obulungi bye batera okwambala, mwe balimbira abalala, okukuuma erinnya lyabwe, n’okwefunira obwesige bw’abalala n’okukuzibwa, n’okunyweza n’okukakasa ebyagalo byabwe, okutuusa lwe balaba omukisa omulungi okutandika okwasanguza mu lwatu ennyo n’okubunyisa enjigiriza zaabwe ezoonoonese.

(2) Mufube okufuna omuntu alina erinnya erinywevu, ng’omuntu ow’eddiini ey’amazima n’okutya Katonda okw’ebbugumu.

Kya bukulu nnyo abo abateekebwa mu mulimu guno okuba abantu ab’okutya Katonda okwa ddala, mu biseera byonna, ne mu bifo byonna; naye naddala mu biseera ebimu, ne mu bibuga ebimu ne mu kkanisa ezimu. Era ekiseera kino ekya kaakano, ekiseera eddiini mw’eri mu kabi, olw’obwonoonefu bungi bwe butyo mu njigiriza ne mu bikolwa, kye kiseera mu ngeri ey’enjawulo abaweereza ng’abo mwe beetaagisa. Tewali kirala wabula okutya Katonda okw’amazima okw’omutima ekiyinza okwesigibwa n’akatono, mu kiseera nga kino, ng’obukuumi eri omuvubuka, nga yaakayingira mu nsi, okuva mu kusiigibwa okubunye, oba okumuleetera ddala okufuba okutuufu era okuvaamu ebirungi okuziyiza n’okuwakanya amataba g’ensobi n’obusosozi ebiwakanya enjigiriza ez’enjiri ez’ekitiibwa, ez’ekyama, ez’eddiini ya Yesu Kristo, n’ebivaamu byazo ebya ddala mu ddiini ey’obumanyirivu ey’amazima. Era ekifo kino kifo ekyetaaga mu ngeri ey’enjawulo omuweereza ng’oyo, olw’ensonga eziri mu lwatu eri bonna.

Singa mubeera mussaawo omuweereza atamanyi kintu kyonna mu mazima ku Kristo n’ekkubo ery’obulokozi okuyita mu ye, atamanyi kintu kyonna mu bumanyirivu ku butonde bw’eddiini ennamu; zitusanze, nga mulibeera mu kabi ng’endiga ezitaliiko musumba! Wano wetaaga omuntu mu kifo kino, aliba asaanidde ddala okuyimirira mu kituli n’okuzimba olukomera, era aliba ng’amagaali ga Isirayiri n’abeebagala embalaasi baayo. Mwetaaga omuntu aliyimirira ng’omuzira mu nsonga y’amazima n’amaanyi g’okutya Katonda.

Bwe mmaze okwogera mu bufunze ku nsonga zino enkulu ez’okubuulirira, tewali kisigaddeyo wabula kaakano okubasiibula, n’okubagamba mwenna nti mweraba; nga mbagaliza era nga mbasabira okukulaakulana okusinga obulungi. Kaakano nandyagadde okukwasa emmeeme zammwe ezitafa oyo eyazinkwasa edda, nga nsuubira olunaku, lwe kirinteekwa okubasisinkana nate mu maaso ge, oyo ye Mulamuzi w’abalamu n’abafu. Njagala obuteerabira n’akatono abantu bano, ababadde abange abaakwasibwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo, era obutalekera ddala kusaba n’ebbugumu olw’okukulaakulana kwammwe. Katonda abawe omukisa ogw’omusumba omwesigwa, oyo amanyi obulungi ekirowoozo kye n’okwagala kwe, alabula ddala aboonoonyi, akebera abeeyatuzi mu magezi n’obukugu, era abakulembera mu kkubo erituusa mu mukisa ogutaggwaawo. Mufune ddala ettaala eyaka era emasamasa eteekeddwa mu kikondo kino; era mubeere, si akaseera kokka, wabula mu bulamu bwe bwonna, era obwo obulamu obuwanvu, nga mwetegefu okusanyukira ekitangaala kye.

Era nzijukirwenga mu kusaba kw’abantu ba Katonda bonna ab’omwoyo omukkakkamu, ab’emirembe era abeesigwa mu Isirayiri, ne bwe baba ab’endowooza ki ku bisaanyizo by’okussa ekimu mu kkanisa.

Era ffenna ka tujjukirenga era tuleme kwerabira n’akatono okusisinkana kwaffe okw’ekitiibwa okugenda okujja ku lunaku olwo olukulu olwa Mukama; olunaku olw’okusalawo okutasobya n’okusalirwa omusango okutaggwaawo era okutakyuka. Amiina.

fields.title: Ebinnyonnyola
fields.body_html:
KATONDA AGULUMIZIBWA MU KWESIGAMA KW’OMUNTU

1. Katonda Agulumizibwa. Olupapula olw’omutwe olw’enfulumya eyasooka ey’obubaka buno, omulimu ogwasooka omuwandiisi gwe yafulumya, lusoma bwe luti: “Katonda Agulumizibwa mu Mulimu gw’Obununuzi olw’Obunene bw’Okwesigama kw’Omuntu ku Ye, mu Bwonna bwagwo. Bwabuulirwa mu Kuyigiriza okw’Olwatu e Boston, nga 8 Julaay, 1731. Era bwafulumizibwa olw’Okwagala kw’Abaweereza n’Abalala abawerako, ab’e Boston, abaabuwulira. Bwa Jonathan Edwards A.M. Omusumba w’Ekkanisa ya Kristo e Northampton. Ekyabalamuzi 7:2.—Abayisirayiri baleme okwennyumiriza gye ndi, nga bagamba nti, omukono gwange gwe gunnokodde. Boston: Bwakubibwa S. Kneeland ne T. Green, ku lwa D. Henchman, ku Dduuka ery’oku Nsonda ku Ludda olw’Obukiikaddyo obw’Ennyumba y’Ekibuga. 1731.”

Okuyigiriza okw’Olwatu oba okw’Olw’Okuna, okwatandika okuva ku kutikkirwa kwa Rev. John Cotton, mu 1633, ne kugenda mu maaso nga kuluusi kusalibwako okutuusa ku kuzingizibwa kwa 1775, oluvannyuma ne kuzzibwawo era nga kukyaliwo, bwe kigambibwa, n’okutuusa kaakano, oba okutuusa gye buvuddeko (laba Ennyanjula ya Dr. Samuel A. Eliot mu Pioneers of Religious Liberty in America, Boston, 1903), kwali kumanyiddwa nnyo mu nteekateeka z’abantu n’ez’eddiini ez’e Boston mu biseera by’amatwale. Mu kiseera ekimu Olukiiko Olukulu lwayimirizanga emirimu gyalwo bulijjo olw’akwo; nti Gavana yandikuzizza Ssekukkulu n’akulagajjalira, Omulamuzi Sewall omukadde yakitwala ng’ekintu eky’okunenyezebwa ennyo. Ababuulizi baalondebwanga mu bamanyi b’eby’eddiini abasinga obumanyifu, si ab’e Boston bokka, wabula ab’omu ttwale lyonna. Kiwandiikiddwa, okugeza, ku Solomon Stoddard, jjajja wa Edwards era eyamukulembera mu busumba bw’e Northampton, nti buli mwaka yabangawo ku mukolo gw’okutikkira e Harvard ate olunaku oluddako n’abuulira mu Kuyigiriza okw’Olwatu. N’olwekyo kyali kitiibwa kinene eri Edwards, omuvubuka ow’emyaka amakumi abiri mu musanvu, okuyitibwa okubuulira ku mukolo guno.

Ye kennyini alabika nga yategeera bulungi ekitiibwa n’omukisa ebyo byombi. Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono ekyasooka kiraga okwetegeka okw’obwegendereza ennyo. Mu kunnyonnyola Enjigiriza, okugeza, mulimu okusangulamu n’okutereeza okuwerako nga ekigambo ekituufu tekinnazuulibwa. Obubaka obwakubibwa bulaga okwongerako okusingawo. Edwards yalonda ng’omulamwa gwe ekitundu kimu eky’omulamwa ogwali wakati era ogwafuga ebirowoozo bye—obufuzi bwa Katonda. Omutima gwe gwali gufumiitiriza ku mulamwa guno mu ngeri zaagwo zonna okuva mu buto. Yali afumiitirizza nnyo ku gwo naddala nga bwe gukwatagana n’enjigiriza y’ebyo Katonda bye yateekateeka, enjigiriza gye yasooka okulaba nga ya kyenyinyalwa, naye ku nkomerero n’agiraba nga “ya ssanyu nnyo, etangaala, era ewooma.” Tewali n’omu okuva ku Augustine eyali akaatiriza nga ye obufuzi bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo n’okwesigama kw’omuntu okukwatagana nabwo. Endowooza eno ey’okwagala kwa Katonda okw’obufuzi bwe—obw’obufuzi, si nga obutaliimu nsonga oba obutakwatagana na bwenkanya n’obulungi bwa Katonda, wabula nga “obutaliiko kiziyiza, oba kikaka, oba buvunaanyizibwa”—teyali mugongo gwa nteekateeka ye yokka, wabula n’omutima gwayo, omusingi oguleeta obulamu era ogukubira mu yo yonna. Gwe musingi ogusembayo ogw’obufirosoofo bwe n’okukkiriza kwe okw’eddiini. Mu kino ekyasooka okufulumizibwa kwe ng’ebiwandiiko ebinene eby’eby’eddiini ebyali ebisembayo bwe biri, buli wamu ye muwolereza afaanana nga nnabbi ow’endowooza eno esingayo, ng’awakanya enteekateeka zonna ez’eby’eddiini, ezitera okuyitibwa eza Arminius, ezaategeezanga mu ndowooza ye eddaala ly’obwetwaze mu muntu eritakkiriziganya na bufuzi obutaliiko kkomo bwe yatwalanga ng’ekitiibwa ekyawula Katonda.

Obubaka buno bwaleeta okukwatibwako okw’amaanyi, nga bwe kyeyoleka mu kwagala okw’amangu okw’okubufulumya, okulagibwa ku lupapula olw’omutwe, ne mu nnyanjula ey’okusiima ey’enfulumya eyasooka eyassibwako emikono abaweereza babiri abasinga obukulu ab’e Boston, Rev. Thomas Prince, ow’Ekkanisa ey’Obukiikaddyo Enkadde, ne Rev. William Cooper, ow’Ekkanisa ey’oku Luguudo lwa Brattle. “Tekyali kyangu,” abaami bano bwe bawandiika, “okusendasenda obuvubuka n’obwetoowaze bw’omuwandiisi, okumukkiriza okulabika ng’omubuulizi mu kuyigiriza kwaffe okw’olwatu, n’oluvannyuma okutuwa ekiwandiiko ky’okwogera kwe, olw’okwagala kw’abaweereza ab’enjawulo, n’abalala abaakuwulira. Naye, nga bwe twamulaba amangu nga mukozi atakwatibwa nsonyi mu maaso ga baganda be, okumatira kwaffe kwali kunene okusingawo, okumulaba ng’alonze omulamwa ogw’ekitiibwa bwe gutyo, era ng’agwogerako n’amaanyi mangi bwe gatyo n’obutangaavu, ng’ab’amagezi bwe banaakiraba mu kuwandiika kuno okuddako: omulamwa ogukakasa eri Katonda ekigendererwa kye ekikulu, mu mulimu gw’obununuzi bw’omuntu eyagwa okuyita mu Mukama Yesu Kristo, ogwategekebwa mu lwatu bwe gutyo, ekitiibwa kyagwo kyonna kidde gy’ali ng’oyo ow’omukisa eyaguteekateeka, eyagugula, era agussa ku bantu; omulamwa oguyingira ennyo mu ddiini ey’okukola; nga awatali kuguzikkiriza, eddiini eyo eteekwa okufa amangu mu mitima ne mu bulamu bw’abantu. N’olwekyo tetuyinza butalaga ssanyu lyaffe n’okwebaza kwaffe, nti Omutwe omukulu ow’Ekkanisa akyasiima okuyimusa, okuva mu baana b’abantu be, olw’okujjuza ekkanisa ze, abo abakakasa era abakuuma emisingi gino egy’enjiri; era nti ekkanisa zaffe, newakubadde nga zonna ziserebye, zikyassa nnyo ekitiibwa mu misingi emituufu, ne mu abo abagikkiriza n’abagiyigiriza mu lwatu. Era, nga bwe tutayinza butayagala na kusaba, nti Ettendekero ery’omu ttwale eriraanyeewo, wamu n’eryaffe, libeere nnyina abala abaana bangi ng’omuwandiisi; bwe tutyo tusanyuka n’omutima gwonna, mu kusiima okw’enjawulo okw’Obulabirizi bwa Katonda, mu kuwa ekirabo eky’omuwendo bwe kityo eri ekkanisa ey’omukisa ey’e Northampton, eyakulaakulana, okumala emyaka mingi bwe gityo, wansi w’obuyinza bw’enjigiriza ez’okutya Katonda ng’ezo, ze baayigirizibwa mu buweereza obulungi ennyo obw’omusumba waabwe ow’ekitiibwa eyafa gye buvuddeko, ekirabo kye n’omwoyo gwe bye tusuubira nti binaabeera bulamu era binaayakaayakananga ebbanga ddene mu muzzukulu we, balyoke bajjule ebibala byonna ebirungi eby’obwetoowaze n’okwebaza okw’enjiri, olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda.”

6. Lwali lwa kisa kyokka ... eri emmeeme zaffe. Ekitundu kino kiyinza okulaga engeri Edwards gye yagaziyangamu obubaka bwe olw’okukubibwa (laba Ennyanjula, olupapula xxix). Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono kisoma bwe kiti: “Ekisa mu kuwa Ekirabo kino kyali kinene okusinziira ku butasaanira bwaffe, kyaweebwa ffe abaali, mu kifo ky’okusaanira ekyo ekya K. eky’Omuwendo Ogutaliiko Kkomo bwe gutyo, twasaanira Ebibi Ebitaliiko Kkomo okuva gy’ali.” Awo ne waddirira ebbanga, waggulu we ne wansi we, wakati w’ennyiriri, waliwo ebigambo, “okusinziira ku mukisa gwe tulina omugaso gwe tuweereddwa mu ye.” Ne kugenda mu maaso: “omugabi mu kuwa ekirabo kino mukulu okusinziira ku ngeri y’okuwa. Yamutuwa ng’Afuuse Omuntu yamutuwa ng’attiddwa alyoke abeere ekijjulo eri emmeeme zaffe.”

OBUTUUFU BW’EKITANGAALA EKY’OMWOYO

21. Ekitangaala eky’Obwakatonda era eky’Ekitalo. Olupapula olw’omutwe olwasooka olw’obubaka buno, obubaka obwokubiri omuwandiisi bwe yafulumya, lusoma bwe luti: “Ekitangaala eky’Obwakatonda era eky’Ekitalo, Ekiweebwa Mmeeme Butereevu olw’Omwoyo wa Katonda, nga kiragiddwa okuba Enjigiriza ey’Ebyawandiikibwa era ey’Amagezi; Mu Bubaka Obwabuulirwa e Northampton, era Obwafulumizibwa olw’Okwagala kw’Abamu ku Bawulize. Bwa Jonathan Edwards, A.M. Omusumba w’Ekkanisa eyo. Yobu 28:20. Kale amagezi gava ludda wa? N’okutegeera kubeera ludda wa? Engero 2:6. Mukama awa amagezi. Isaaya 42:18. Mutunule mmwe bamuzibe, mulabe. 2 Peetero 1:19. Okutuusa obudde lwe bukya, emunyeenye ey’enkya n’eryoka eyaka mu mitima gyammwe. Boston: Bwakubibwa S. Kneeland ne T. Green, M,DCC,XXXIV.” Obubaka buno bulina ennyanjula Edwards mw’awakanyiza mu bwetoowaze obwagazi bwonna obw’okwerabika oba okwewaana mu kubufulumya era n’asaba abasomi be okubusoma awatali kusosola ku nsonga eno, oba olw’omulamwa okuba nga si gwa musono. Kino eri abantu bonna okutwalira awamu. Ky’agamba abantu be kennyini kiraga enkolagana yaabwe eri omuweereza waabwe omuvubuka bwe yali ey’okwagalana mu kiseera kino era okussaamu ekitiibwa kwe yalina gye bali bwe kwali kunene; kirina ensonga ey’ennaku bw’olowooza ku kumugaana kwabwe okw’obusungu ku nkomerero. “Nnina ensonga okwebaza Katonda,” bw’awandiika, “nti waliwo obumu obw’essanyu wakati waffe, okusinga mmwe okusosola ekintu kyonna ekyange, kubanga kyange.” Abayozaayoza olw’okuba nga baayigirizibwa enjigiriza ng’ezo eziri mu bubaka okuva ku lubereberye. “Era nkisanyukira,” bw’ayongerako, “nti Obulabirizi bwa Katonda, mu kiseera kino eky’Obwonoonefu n’Okutabulwa, bwateeka omugabo gwange awo enjigiriza ng’ezo, ze ntwala ennyo ng’obulamu n’ekitiibwa ky’Enjiri, si nti zikkirizibwa bukkirizibwa, wabula awali bangi bwe batyo, amazima gaazo mwe geeyolekera bwe gatyo mu bumanyirivu bwabwe, nti omuntu yenna eyafuna omukisa okubamanya, mu nsonga ng’ezo, nga nze bwe nnagufuna, ateekwa okuba atali wa magezi nnyo okukibuusabuusa.”

Kino kitwalibwa mu butuufu nga “bumu ku bubaka bwa Edwards obusinga obulungi n’okwogera obulungi” (A. V. G. Allen, Jonathan Edwards, olupapula 67). Bwabuulirwa mu kiseera obubonero bwe bwali bweyongera obw’okufaayo okweyongera ku ddiini mu bantu b’e Northampton, ekyakulembera okuzuukuka okunene okw’omwaka ogwaddirira n’egyagoberera. Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono ekyasooka kiriko olunaku, Agusito, 1733. Okufa kw’Omwami Stoddard mu 1729 kwali kuggyewo ebiziyiza eby’obuyinza obwali bumaze ebbanga ddene nga bunywevu era nga tebubuusibwabuusibwa, era ebyavaamu, nga Edwards bw’abinnyonnyola, byali bya nnaku. “Kyalabika,” bw’agamba, “nga kiseera kya kuwola okw’ekitalo mu ddiini: obugwenyufu okumala emyaka egimu bwabuna nnyo mu bavubuka b’ekibuga; bangi ku bo baali bamanyidde nnyo okutambula ekiro, n’okugendanga mu mayumba g’omwenge, n’ebikolwa eby’obugwenyufu, abamu mwe baayonoonera ennyo abalala olw’ekyokulabirako kyabwe.” “Naye mu myaka ebiri oba esatu ... waatandika okubaawo okulongooka okulabika okw’obubi buno,” era “ku nkomerero y’omwaka 1733, waalabika obugonvu obutali bwa bulijjo n’okukkiriza okubuulirirwa” mu bavubuka (Narrative of Surprising Conversions). Embeera ennungi zaakwata ku mubuulizi era, olw’ekyo, tulina obubaka ku Kitangaala eky’Omwoyo.

Omusingi ogulangirirwa mu bubaka buno gwe musingi omukulu era ogufuga okuzuukuka kwonna. Okuzuukuka kwe kweyoleka kwagwo kwennyini n’obukakafu obw’obumanyirivu, eri Edwards waakiri, obw’amazima gaagwo. Tewali kintu mu kunnyonnyola kwe okw’okuzuukuka kuno ekisinga okukwata ku mutima okusinga engeri gy’akwekenneenyamu, ng’alondoola mu bujjuvu ebitundu by’enkola, ng’eyewuunya enjawulo zaakwo, Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw’afuulira obubaka bwa Katonda obwa ddala era obw’amaanyi (laba Allen, op. cit. olupapula 143 n’ezigoberera). Tewaali kintu kiggya ddala mu musingi gwennyini; nti Katonda akwata ku mmeeme butereevu, nti emmeeme esobola okutegeera butereevu ebintu bya Katonda, kino kyali kyayigirizibwa bonna, naddala bonna ab’Ekikristaayo, abeewaayo eri ebyama by’omwoyo. Mazima, kiyinza okubuusibwabuusibwa oba eddiini ng’engeri y’obumanyirivu bw’omuntu tetwaliramu wonna okumanya enkolagana ng’eyo esukkulumye (laba W. James, Varieties of Religious Experience, Boston, 1902, passim). Ekyali ekiggya mu ngeri Edwards gye yategekamu enjigiriza eno kye kyali engeri gy’aginnyonnyolamu, engeri gy’agikwataganyaamu n’ebitundu ebirala eby’enteekateeka ye, okunyweza kwe ku butonde obw’ekitalo obw’okutangaaza kuno okw’obwakatonda, okwawula kwe okw’amaanyi wakati w’ekisa ekya bulijjo n’ekisa eky’enjawulo. Enjigiriza ye ey’ekitangaala eky’ekitalo erabika, mazima, ng’ekiva mu ndowooza ye ku nkolagana y’omuntu ne Katonda mu mulimu gw’obununuzi eyalagibwa mu bubaka bwe ku Kwesigama kw’Omuntu. Kitundu, waakiri, olw’endowooza eno nti erabika gy’ali si ya Byawandiikibwa yokka, wabula ya magezi. Yali njigiriza ekwatagana ennyo n’endowooza ze ku kukyuka. Olw’ensonga eno, si kitono okusinga olw’okukaatiriza kwayo omusingi ogw’ebyama by’omwoyo okusinga ogw’empisa oba ogw’amateeka mu ddiini, Edwards kyava ayinza okwogera ku njigiriza eno nga “si ya musono.” Endowooza ey’omulembe ogwo yali ya kusanga amaanyi mangi mu butonde bw’omuntu okusinga bwe yali ayagala okukkiriza. Mu byafaayo, naye, mu kukaatiriza kuno kwennyini ku bumanyirivu obw’omunda obw’ekitangaala n’obulamu bwa Katonda mu mutima Edwards mw’akolera enkyukakyuka okuva mu njigiriza ya Calvin enkadde okudda mu by’eddiini ebigazi eby’omulembe gwaffe.

Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono eky’obubaka buno kijjudde nnyo okusinga bulijjo okusangulamu n’okuyingizaamu, ne kiba nga kumpi tekisobola kusomebwa, naye nga kiraga ekitundu ky’okutegana n’okufaayo okwakozesebwa mu kukiwandiika. Kiwandiikiddwa ku mpapula amakumi abiri mu mukaaga ez’obunene bw’ekifaananyi ekikoppoddwa mu kitabo kino, olupapula olusembayo nga lulimu olunyiriri lumu n’ekitundu kyokka. Naye obubaka obwakubibwa bugaziyiziddwa nnyo okusingawo.

OKUSALAWO KWA LUUSI

45. Okusalawo kwa Luusi. Obubaka buno bwali bumu ku “Kwogera” bitaano “ku Nsonga ez’Enjawulo Enkulu, Ezikwata ennyo ku Nsonga Enkulu ey’Obulokozi bw’Emmeeme Obutaggwaawo: kwe kugamba I. Okuweebwa Obutuukirivu olw’Okukkiriza Kwokka. II. Okufuba Okuyingira mu Bwakabaka bwa Katonda. III. Okusalawo kwa Luusi. IV. Obwenkanya bwa Katonda mu Kuzikirizibwa kw’Aboonoonyi. V. Obulungi bwa Yesu Kristo. Bwabuulirwa e Northampton, naddala mu kiseera ky’okufukibwa okw’ekitalo okw’Omwoyo wa Katonda eyo okwakayita. Bwa Jonathan Edwards A.M. Omusumba w’Ekkanisa ya Kristo e Northampton. Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 4:8 [9]—Weekuume nnyo, okuume emmeeme yo n’obunyiikivu, olemenga kwerabira ebyo amaaso go bye galabye, era bireme okuva mu mutima gwo ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwo. Boston: Bwakubibwa era bwatundibwa S. Kneeland ne T. Green, ku Luguudo lwa Queen okwolekera Ekkomera. MDCCXXXVIII.” Okwogera kuna okwasooka kwabuulirwa mu kiseera ky’okuzuukuka kwa 1734-1735 era kwalondebwa olw’okwagala kw’abantu ng’okwo kwe baali bafunyeemu omugaso ogw’enjawulo; okwokutaano kwalondebwa Edwards yennyini ng’abantu abamu okuva mu kibuga ekiriraanyeewo abaakuwulira bamusabye, era kubanga yalowooza nti obubaka ku bulungi bwa Kristo bwandisaanidde okugoberera okulala, okwali okw’okuzuukusa. Kwateekebwa mu maaso g’enfulumya ey’e Amerika eya Narrative of Surprising Conversions, eyasooka okufulumizibwa mu Bungereza. Ensimbi ez’okubufulumya zaasasulwa ekibiina,—obukakafu obweyoleka obw’okufaayo kwabwe okw’omu buziba, kubanga mu kiseera ekyo baali bazitoowereddwa nnyo ensimbi ez’ennyumba y’okusabiramu empya. Laba Dwight, Life of Edwards, olupapula 140 n’oluddako; geraageranya n’ekinnyonnyola ekiddako wano, olupapula 162.

Obubaka ku Kusalawo kwa Luusi bulondeddwa ng’obusinga obumpi mu kwogera kuno waggulu okulaga ekika ky’obubaka obw’okuzuukuka ekyawukana ennyo ku bubaka ku Boonoonyi mu Mikono gya Katonda Asunguwadde. Bwonna, naye, bukakasa obujulirwa bwa Edwards yennyini ku kubuulira kwe: “Sifubye kubazuukusa kyokka, mulyoke mukwatibwe okutya, wabula nkozesezza amaanyi gange gonna okubawangula” (Obubaka bw’Okusiibula). Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono eky’obubaka buno kiriko olunaku, Apuli, 1735, era kirabika nga kyakubibwa kumpi nga bwe kyawandiikibwa.

EBISENGE EBINGI

59. Ebisenge Ebingi. Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono eky’obubaka buno obutannaba kufulumizibwa kiriko olunaku, “Ssabbiiti eddirira okutuuza abantu mu Nnyumba y’Okusabiramu Empya, 25 Ddesemba, 1737.” Omukolo ogwo gwali gwa kufaayo okw’enjawulo eri abantu b’e Northampton. Ennyumba y’okusabiramu enkadde, eyazimbibwa mu 1661, yali efuuse ntono nnyo eri ekibiina era ng’eyonoonese mu ngeri ey’akabi; mazima, ku Ssande emu mu Maaki mu mwaka ekizimbe ekipya mwe kyaggwa, Edwards nga abuulira, nga yaakamala “okuteekawo enjigiriza ze” okuva mu kyawandiikibwa, “Mulabe, mmwe abanyoomi, musamaalirire era muzikirire,” ekituuti eky’omu maaso, “n’okuwuuma ng’okubwatuka kw’eggulu,” ne kigwa mangu era mu ngeri eyeewuunyisa. Ku bw’omukisa—olw’obulabirizi obw’enjawulo, bwe kyalabika eri Edwards—tewali n’omu ku bantu ekikumi mu ataano, oba abasukkako oba abatawera, abaali mu kabenje ako eyafa, oba eyamenyeka eggumba, era kkumi bokka be baalumizibwa “ne kiba eky’ensonga ennene.” Naye ekyabaawo kyalaga nti okuzimba ennyumba y’okusabiramu empya kwali tekutandikiddwa mangu ekimala. Ensonga y’ekizimbe kino ekipya yali ereeteddwa mu lukiiko lw’ekibuga olw’omusana gwa 1733, naye yasooka kusalibwawo mu Novemba, 1735, nga eyambiddwa kitundu, awatali kubuusabuusa, okuzuukuka okunene okw’omwaka ogwo, abantu nkaaga, kinaana, n’ekikumi bwe baakkirizibwanga mu kkanisa ku mikolo gy’Ekyeggulo egyaddiriŋŋananga. Awo ne kitwala emyaka ebiri okumaliriza ekizimbe. Mu ngeri endala, galoni nkaaga mu mwenda ez’omwenge omukambwe, ng’oggyeeko ebipipa bingi eby’omwenge gw’ebibala n’ogwa bbaale, byanywebwa abakozi mu kuzimba omubiri gw’emiti gwokka. Abasajja nkaaga baakozesebwa ku silingi 5 buli lunaku olw’ekitundu kino eky’omulimu, “nga beerabirira bokka”—nga ekitabo kya Dikoni Hunt bwe kigamba—“okuggyako eby’okunywa.”

Ekizimbe bwe kyali kumpi okuggwa, ng’ebirala ebiwerako eby’ekiseera ekyo, ekizimbe ekigazi, ekiwanvu nga kiriko omunaala, ekifo ky’ekide n’ekyuma ekiraga empewo ku nkomerero emu, ensonga enkulu ey’okutuuza ekibiina n’etandikibwako. Kino nakyo kyali kya kibuga. Kyali kimaze okusalibwawo mu lukiiko lw’ekibuga olwa buli mwaka mu musana okubeera n’entebe ez’amasanduuko okwetooloola ebisenge n’“entebe” oba entebe empanvu zokka ku njuyi zombi ez’“ekkubo” (ekkubo eddene wakati). Enteekateeka yennyini ey’entebe, ekyaliwo, eraga entebe ez’amasanduuko nazo nga zeetoolodde entebe empanvu ku wansi, nga zaawuddwa ku ntebe ez’amasanduuko ez’oku bisenge amakubo amafunda, n’entebe ez’amasanduuko ttaano mu kituuti. Entebe zino ez’amasanduuko zaali za ngeri empanvu, ennya enkulungo, nga zirina entebe ezisitulibwa, era zaali zirabibwa mu lwatu ng’ebifo eby’ekitiibwa ekisingako. Ku nkomerero y’omwaka, ekibuga ne kikuba enkiiko eziwerako nga kitunuulidde naddala okutuuza abantu. Ensonga esooka obukulu yali ekwata ku kugabanya entebe okusinziira ku ddaala ly’omuntu mu bantu. Mu lukiiko mu Novemba, akakiiko k’abatuuze bataano abasinga obumanyifu kaalagirwa okukola “Enteekateeka yaabwe oba Pulaani y’Okutuuza abantu mu Nnyumba y’Okusabiramu n’okugireeta eri Ekibuga” okugikkiriza. Omwezi ogwaddirira akakiiko ne kalagirwa nate n’obululu buno obuddako:

“1. Kyasalibwawo nti mu Kutuuza abantu mu nnyumba y’okusabiramu Empya akakiiko kafeeyo okusingira ddala ku bintu by’abantu.

“2. Okufaayo ku Myaka gy’abantu.

“3. Kyasalibwawo nti wabeewo Okufaayo n’Ekitiibwa ebimu [bissibwe] ku mugaso gw’abantu, naye ku Ddaala erya wansi.” Era waleme kubaawo nsobi yonna, akakiiko k’abantu mukaaga kaalondebwa “okubalirira omuwendo gw’entebe ez’amasanduuko n’entebe,” kwe kugamba, okuzissaamu “ekitiibwa” oba okuzibalirira omuwendo gwazo mu bantu.

Ensonga endala ekwatagana yali ekwata ku kutuuza abasajja n’abakazi. Mu lukiiko mu Novemba, kyasalibwawo nti abasajja babeere ku nkomerero ey’obukiikaddyo, abakazi ku nkomerero ey’obukiikakkono; abasajja ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogw’ekituuti ky’okubuulirirako, abakazi ku gwa kkono. Mu lukiiko olwasooka mu Ddesemba ekibuga kyagaana mu lwatu okukkiriza abasajja ne bakazi baabwe okutuula wamu. Naye kino kyali kikontana mu lwatu n’endowooza y’abamu ku b’ekibuga abasinga obuyinza, kubanga mu lukiiko olwaddibwamu oluvannyuma lw’ennaku nnya, “Ekibuuzo bwe kyabuuzibwa oba Akakiiko kaziyizibwe okutuuza abasajja n’abakazi baabwe wamu, Naddala Abo Abaagala Okutuula wamu: Kyagaanibwa.” Wansi w’olukusa luno olutali lwa butereevu era olulina obukwakkulizo, abafumbo baatuuzibwa okusinga obungi wamu mu ntebe ez’amasanduuko, naye nga baawuddwa ku ntebe empanvu, ate mu mbeera ezimu omwami n’aweebwa entebe ey’essanduuko ate omukyala entebe empanvu.

Ebyabaawo n’embeera ezinnyonnyoddwa wano birabikira mu bubaka bwa Edwards, naddala mu by’ayogera ku bunene bw’“ebifo eby’okusulamu” mu ggulu ne mu bigambo bye ku “ntebe ez’ekitiibwa eky’enjawulo n’amadaala ag’enjawulo n’embeera ez’ekitiibwa n’essanyu” eyo, bw’ogeraageranya n’ebyo bye tusanga mu mayumba ag’okusinza ku nsi.

Ng’okulaga obunene bw’ekibiina kya Edwards eky’e Northampton, kiyinza okuba eky’okwewuunya okulaba nti enteekateeka y’okutuuza eyogeddwako waggulu erimu amannya g’abantu kumpi lukaaga. Era yalina abawulize be nga bamwetoolodde. Ekituuti eky’okubuulirirako, nga waggulu waakyo waliwo olubaawo olunene oluzzaayo eddoboozi, kyali wakati w’ekimu ku bisenge ebisinga obuwanvu eby’ekizimbe, si ku nkomerero, nga bwe kiri empisa kaakano. Okumanya ebisingawo, laba J. R. Trumbull, History of Northampton, Omuzingo II, Essuula 6.

Obubaka buno buwandiikiddwa mu bujjuvu okusinga obubaka bwa Edwards obusinga obungi obutannafulumizibwa. Mu kutegeka ekiwandiiko ky’ekitabo kino, omukung’aanya yalina mu birowoozo engeri obubaka obulala obufulumiziddwa wano gye bufaananamu okutwalira awamu. Obufunze—X (Kristo), G. (Katonda), F. H. (Ennyumba ya Kitange), n’ebirala—bwe butyo bunnyonnyoddwa, era emboozi oba ebigambo ebyalekebwayo, ebiragibwa mu Kiwandiiko eky’omukono n’obusittale oba amabanga, byongeddwamu okusinziira ku bigambo ebibyetoolodde. Ebyongeddwamu byonna ng’ebyo, naye, biyingiziddwa mu bukomera obw’enjuyi ennya.

ABOONOONYI MU MIKONO GYA KATONDA ASUNGUWADDE

78. Aboonoonyi mu Mikono gya Katonda Asunguwadde. Olupapula olw’omutwe olujjuvu olw’obubaka buno, obusinga obumanyifu mu bwa Edwards, lwasomanga mu nfulumya eyasooka bwe luti: “Aboonoonyi mu Mikono gya Katonda Asunguwadde. Obubaka Obwabuulirwa e Enfield, nga 8 Julaay 1741. Mu kiseera eky’Okuzuukuka okunene; era nga kwaliko okukwatibwako okw’ekitalo ku bangi ku Bawulize. Bwa Jonathan Edwards A.M. Omusumba w’Ekkanisa ya Kristo e Northampton. Amosi 9:2, 3.—Ne bwe balisima ne baddukira emagombe, omukono gwange gulibaggyayo. Ne bwe balirinnya waggulu mu ggulu ndibawanulayo. Wadde balyekweka ku lusozi Kalumeeri, ndibanoonyaayo ne mbaggyayo. Ne bwe balyekweka wansi mu buziba bw’ennyanja ndiragira ogusota ne gubalumirayo. Boston: Bwakubibwa era Bwatundibwa S. Kneeland ne T. Green ku Luguudo lwa Queen okwolekera Ekkomera, 1741.”

Benjamin Trumbull mu History of Connecticut ye (New Haven, 1818), Omuzingo II, olupapula 145, awandiika embeera mwe bwabuulirwa obubaka buno nga bwe yabubuulirwa Omwami Wheelock, omuweereza okuva e Connecticut (Enfield, Conn., mu kiseera ekyo kyali kibalibwa mu ssaza lya Hampshire, Mass.), eyabuwulira. “Abantu mu bibuga ebiriraanyeewo,” Trumbull bw’awandiika, “bwe baali mu nnaku ennene olw’emmeeme zaabwe, abatuuze b’ekibuga ekyo baali beekakasa nnyo, nga tebeefuga, era nga tebalina kye bafaako. Okuyigiriza kwali kutegekeddwa e Enfield, era abantu ab’okumpi, ekiro ekyakulembera, baakwatibwako nnyo olw’obutafaayo bw’abatuuze, era nga batya nnyo nti Katonda yandibayiseeko, mu kusala kwe okw’obutuukirivu, ng’enkuba ya Katonda etonnya okubetooloola wonna, ne bavunnama mu maaso ge ekitundu kinene eky’ekiro ekyo, nga basaba okusaasirwa olw’emmeeme zaabwe. Ekiseera ekyategekebwa olw’okuyigiriza bwe kyatuuka, abaweereza ab’okumpi bangi ne bajja, n’abamu okuva ewala. Bwe baayingira mu nnyumba y’okusabiramu, endabika y’ekibiina yali ya butafaayo era nga temuli kantu. Abantu baali kumpi tebeeyisa na mpisa za bulijjo. Rev. Omwami Edwards, ow’e Northampton, n’abuulira, era obubaka nga tebunnaggwa, ekibiina ne kirabika nga kikwatiddwako nnyo era nga kivunnamye, n’okukakasibwa okw’entiisa okw’ekibi kyabwe n’akabi kaabwe. Waaliwo okussa omukka okw’ennaku n’okukaaba okungi bwe kutyo, omubuulizi n’akakibwa okwogera eri abantu n’okusaba basirike, alyoke awulirwe. Kino kye kyali entandikwa y’okufaayo kwe kumu okunene era okwabuna mu kifo ekyo, ttwale lyonna kwe lyakyalirwa okutwalira awamu.” Embeera, bwe zityo, obubaka buno mwe bwabuulirwa zaali za njawulo; okusasamala kw’Okuzuukuka Okunene kwali ku ntikko; ekibiina obubaka mwe bwabuulirwa kyali kimanyiddwa nnyo olw’obutafaayo bwakyo; Edwards awatali kubuusabuusa yawulira nti okulaga akabi kaabwe mu ngeri ey’amaanyi ennyo kyali kyetaagisa okubazuukusa. Era obubaka buno oboolyawo bwe businga okutiisa mu kika kyabwo obwali bubuuliddwa omuweereza Omukristaayo yenna.

Ekika ekyo, naye, tekyali kya njawulo n’akatono mu kubuulira kwa Edwards, naddala mu kiseera kino. Bwe yakkiriza nti okusalawo kw’abantu mu bulamu buno kwalimu ebinaavaamu ebisingayo obukulu emirembe n’emirembe, yatwala nti buvunaanyizibwa bwe okubibateeka mu maaso mu ngeri esinga okukwata ku mutima. Obwenkanya bwa Katonda mu Kuzikirizibwa kw’Aboonoonyi; Ekibonerezo eky’Ababi Ekigenda Okujja Tekyewalika era Tekigumiikirizika; Obutaggwaawo bw’Ebibonyoobonyo bya Ggeyeena; Ababi Bwe Balimala Okujjuza Ekipimo ky’Ekibi kyabwe, Obusungu Bulibajjira Okutuuka Ennyo; Enkomerero y’Ababi Efumiitirizibwako Abatuukirivu; oba, Ebibonyoobonyo by’Ababi mu Ggeyeena tebiri nsonga ya nnaku eri Abatukuvu mu Ggulu; Abantu Ababi Bagasa mu Kuzikirizibwa kwabwe Kwokka,—gano gamu ku mitwe gy’obubaka bwe. Ate era, waliwo ensonga okukkiriza nti obubaka buno bwennyini, oba obufaanana nabwo, bwakozesebwa ku mikolo emirala ng’oggyeeko ogwo gwe bulagibwa mu lwatu nti gwe bwabuulirwako. Waliwo eky’ennono nti Edwards yabubuulira omulundi gumu Whitfield bwe yali amalidde ekibiina essuubi bwe yatalabika, era nti yaleeta okukwatibwako okunene olw’abwo. Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono kiriko olunaku Juuni, 1741, ekiraga nti bwandiba nga bwabuulirwa e Northampton, oba awalala, omwezi ogwakulembera okukwatibwako okw’ekitalo bwe kutyo ku bawulize e Enfield. Naye ekisinga obukulu kwe kubeerawo kw’obubaka obwokubiri obutaliiko lunaku okuva mu kyawandiikibwa kye kimu. Mu buno, obwali awatali kubuusabuusa obw’edda okusingawo, ekirowoozo kikoleddwako mu ngeri ey’enjawulo katono: tebutiisa nnyo, tebugaziyiziddwa nnyo, tebukankanya nnyo; naye bulimu ebirowoozo bingi, okugeza, ku butakakafu bw’obulamu, obwangu okuzikirira kwe kuyinza okutuukira omwonoonyi, n’ebirala, ebisangibwa mu bubaka bw’e Enfield. Edwards mu lwatu yasikirizibwa nnyo omulamwa guno; agukolako n’omukono omukakafu ogw’omukozi w’eby’emikono omukulu, n’amaanyi ag’amagezi ag’omukugu mu kukubaganya ebirowoozo. Era alangirira obubaka bwe n’amaanyi g’okukakasibwa okwa nnabbi ow’Endagaano Enkadde. Tekyewuunyisa nti abawulize be baakwatibwako. Ekyavaamu mazima kyandibadde kitono singa waaliwo akabonero konna ak’okuwoolera eggwanga okw’omuntu ku bubwe mu kubuulira. Naye tewali kintu ng’ekyo; si mu ngeri eyo obubaka buno mwe buyinza okuyitibwa “obw’okukolima.” Ku ludda olulala, ku ndowooza ya Edwards ye ku bubwe, si kizibu okulaba mu bwo ennaku n’okusaasira okw’omuntu asinga obukkakkamu ng’akaabira obusirusiru obutaliimu bw’abo, nga bazibe ku kuzikirira okubalindiridde, abagaana okuyitibwa okw’obukuumi okuddiŋŋanwa (geraageranya ne Matayo 23:37). Ku birala, talina by’asosola ku bubwe, ali bweru; amazima g’abuulira gakakafu, ga ntiisa, naye ga ddala. Ku musomi ow’omulembe guno obubaka buyinza okuleeta okukwatibwako okw’obulumi ennyo, okuggyako nga ye, ku ludda lwe, abusoma mu ngeri y’emu etali ya kusosola, ey’obweru. Si kulaga bintu nga bwe biri kwokka, wabula obukakanyavu bw’enjigiriza, obunyiiza. Edwards, okugeza, emirundi mingi ayogera ku nsonga lwaki aboonoonyi tebasuulibwa mangu ago mu ggeyeena; naye ensonga gy’awa si kusaasira oba bulungi oba kwagala kwa Katonda, wabula amaanyi Ge gokka n’okusiima Kwe okw’obufuzi. Eno ngeri emu ey’amazima ag’obutonde obw’omwoyo nga Edwards bw’agalaba. Si muntu agoberera nneewulira; alangirira amazima nga bw’agasanga. Ku bikwata ku Edwards yennyini, tewali kintu mu bubaka bwonna, oba mu bubaka bwe bwonna “obw’okukolima,” nga bwe buyitibwa, ekyenyinyalwa ekitundu ky’endowooza ya Dante ku boonoonyi mu ggeyeena. Twala, okugeza, ensonga ya Filippo Argenti mu Nnyanja y’Ebisooto (Inferno, Oluyimba 8): “‘Mukama wange, nandyagadde nnyo okumulaba ng’annyikibwa mu ssupu ono nga tetunnava ku nnyanja.’ N’ankuddamu nti, ‘Ng’olubalama terunnakukkiriza kukiraba ojja kumatizibwa; kijja kuba kisaanidde nti weeyagalire mu kwegomba ng’okwo.’ Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo katono ne ndaba nga ab’omu bisooto bamuyuzaayuza bwe batyo nti nkyatendereza Katonda olw’ekyo, era mmwebaza olw’akyo. Bonna ne baleekaana nti, ‘Mumukwate Filippo Argenti!’ n’omwoyo ogw’e Florence ogwali gunyiize ne gwekyukira gwokka n’amannyo gaagwo.”

89. Katonda abakwatidde ... temugwa mu ggeyeena. Kino oboolyawo kye kitundu ekisinga okujjukirwa mu bubaka buno obujjukirwa ennyo ekisukkiridde. Okugeraageranya n’ekiwandiiko eky’omukono ekyasooka kulaga enjawulo ezimu ez’okwewuunya ku biwandiiko ebyakubibwa, era mu kiseera kye kimu kulaga obugenderevu sentensi mwe zaakolebwamu nga zitunuulidde ekyo kye zaali zigenderera okuleeta. Olw’ensonga ezo zombi ekitundu kino kizzibwa wano nga bwe kyawandiikibwa.

“Muli waggulu w’obunnya bwa ggeyeena mu mukono gwa Katonda nga bw’ofaanana omuntu akwatira nnabbubi oba Ekiwuka ekyenyinyalwa waggulu w’omuliro & tewali kirala wabula Katonda okubata & ne mugwamu.” (Wano waddirira ennyiriri nnya ezitasobola kusomebwa, naye ezirabika nga tezikwatagana na kino. Ekitundu kino kigenda mu maaso ku lupapula oluddako olw’Ekiwandiiko.) “& K. ono abakwatidde bw’atyo mu mukono gwe abasunguwalidde nnyo & anyiiziddwa mu ngeri ey’entiisa. obusungu bwe bwaka ng’omuliro. muli ba kyenyinyalwa era ba kukyayibwa mu maaso ge & era musaanidde okwokebwa—abatwala nga temusaanira kintu kirala wabula okusuulibwa mu muliro muli ba kyenyinyalwa emirundi nkumi kkumi mu maaso ge okusinga ekiwuka ekisinga okuwunya mu maaso gaffe abantu & mumunyiizizza emirundi lukumi okusinga omujeemu omukakanyavu bwe yali anyiizizza omulangira we. & naye muli mu mikono gye & tewali kintu n’akatono wabula okusiima kwe kwokka okumukuumya obutagwa mu ggeyeena buli kaseera tewali nsonga ndala eyinza okuweebwa lwaki temwagenda mu ggeyeena ekiro ekyayise lwaki temwazuukukira mu ggeyeena oluvannyuma lw’okuzibiriza amaaso gammwe okwebaka & tewali nsonga ndala eyinza okuweebwa lwaki [te]mugudde okuva lwe mwazuukuka ku makya weewaawo okuva lwe mutudde wano mu nnyumba ya K. Nga Munyiiza Amaaso ge amalongoofu olw’engeri yammwe ey’ekibi embi gye muwuliriramu Okusinza kwe Okutukuvu Weewaawo tewali kirala ekiyinza okuweebwa ng’Ensonga lwaki temugwa mu ggeyeena mu kaseera kano kennyini.”

Wakati wa sentensi ezaawuddwa wano n’amabanga amawanvu, mulimu ennyiriri ezikoona okuva ku kitundu ekya wansi eky’esooka okutuuka ku kitundu ekya waggulu eky’eddako, nga ziyinza okulaga okusirika okw’omu kwogera mu kubuulira era nga ziraga omusomi ow’omulembe guno amayengo agaddiriŋŋana, ejjengo ku jjengo ery’entiisa, buli limu nga lisinga okuwuubaaza okusinga eryalikulembera.

Ekitundu ekyo waggulu kiri mu kiwandiiko eky’omukono wansi w’ekitundu I. eky’“Okussa mu Nkola,” ekitundu II. nga kitandika nti, “Era mulowooze wano mu ngeri ey’enjawulo” (olupapula 89). Ebitundu ebina ebigoberera oluvannyuma bikwatagana kumpi n’ebyo ebiri mu nfulumya eyakubibwa, naye mitwe gyokka, era byawukana ku bitundu omukaaga ebyasooka okulambikibwa. Mu kiwandiiko eky’omukono mulimu olupapula olutasibiddwa nga lulimu mu mukono gwa Edwards enteekateeka ey’obwegendereza ey’obubaka bwonna, ng’eyo gye yandikoze ng’ategeka obubaka olw’okukubibwa oba gye yandikozesezza ng’ebiwandiiko eby’okubuulira. Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono eky’obubaka bwonna kimpi, empapula amakumi abiri mu bbiri zokka ez’obuwandiike n’olupapula lumu olutaliiko kintu.

OMUGGO OMUGUMU OGUMENYEDDWA

98. Ekibonerezo kya Katonda eky’Entiisa. Ekiwandiiko eky’omukono eky’obubaka buno kiriko olunaku, “Ku mukolo gw’okufa kwa Col. Stoddard Juuni 1748.” Kirimu empapula ataano mu bbiri ez’obunene obwa bulijjo obw’ebiwandiiko by’obubaka bwa Edwards eby’omukono, naye nga kirina enjawulo etali ya bulijjo ey’okuwandiikibwa mu mpagi bbiri. Empapula ezaakozesebwa zaali kitundu za bbaluwa ezaaweerezebwa Edwards, obuwandiike nga mu bifo ebimu buyita ku ndagiriro, n’obubonero bwa sitampu nga buggiddwawo; ekitundu—empapula nga amakumi abiri—byali bitundu by’empapula ennungi, ennyogovu, ezisaliddwa ennyo okwetooloola emabbali ga waggulu, ezikkirizibwa okuba ebitundutundu by’empapula Mukyala Edwards ne bawala be ze baakozesanga mu kukola eby’okwewujja. Obubaka mu lwatu bwawandiikibwa mu bwangu bungi, n’okutereeza kutono era mu bujjuvu ekimala. Olupapula olw’omutwe olw’enfulumya eyasooka lusoma bwe luti: “Omuggo Omugumu ogumenyeddwa ne guwotoka. Obubaka Obwabuulirwa e Northampton, ku Lunaku lwa Mukama, nga 26 Juuni 1748 Ku Kufa kw’Omwami Ow’ekitiibwa John Stoddard, Esq. Eyali emirundi mingi Omukiise mu Lukiiko lwa Kabaka, Okumala Emyaka mingi Ssabalamuzi wa Kkooti y’Emisango egya Bulijjo mu Ssaza lya Hampshire, Omulamuzi w’Ebiraamo, era Ssaabakolonelo w’Ekibinja, n’ebirala. Eyafiira e Boston nga 19 Juuni 1748. mu Mwaka gwe ogw’67. Bwa Jonathan Edwards A.M. Omusumba w’Ekkanisa esooka e Northampton. Danyeri 4:35—Eggye ery’omu ggulu n’abantu ab’oku nsi abayisa nga bw’asiima. Tewali ayinza okumuziyiza, newaakubadde okumubuuza nti, Okola ki? Boston Bwakubibwa Rogers ne Fowle ku lwa J. Edwards e Cornhill 1748.”

Kolonelo Stoddard yali mwana ow’omunaana era mutabani ow’okuna owa Rev. Solomon Stoddard, era n’olwekyo kojja wa Edwards ku ludda lwa nnyina. Yali muntu ow’obukulu obunene mu nsonga zonna enkulu ez’ekibuga, essaza, n’ettwale. “Obulamu bwe,” bw’agamba Trumbull (History of Northampton, Omuzingo II, olupapula 172), “bwali kiyunzi wakati w’emiddiring’anwa ebiri egy’abakulembeze abakulu abaafuga ensonga za Massachusetts ey’Ebugwanjuba okumala kumpi ekyasa n’ebitundu bisatu ku bina. Abaamukulembera baali John Pynchon ow’e Springfield ne Samuel Partridge ow’e Hatfield; oluvannyuma lwe ne wajja Joseph Hawley ne Caleb Strong ab’e Northampton, era abasajja bano abataano be baali abakulembeze mu Ttwale, mu Ssaza ne mu Ggwanga.” Yali muwagizi munywevu ow’obwakabaka n’obuyinza bwa kabaka, era olw’ensonga eno yalina abamuwakanya bangi; naye okussibwamu ekitiibwa kwe yalina okutwalira awamu kulabibwa mu mirimu gye emingi ne mu kuba nti yalondebwa emirundi kkumi na musanvu okukiikirira essaza mu Lukiiko Olukulu. Yali mukwano wa muwendo eri Gavana Shirley, era ku ekyo waliwo olugero olumulaga bw’ali. Lwe luno nti olumu yagenda n’asaba okulaba Gavana nga Gavana alina abagenyi abalya naye, naye n’agaana omuweereza bwe yamuyita okuyingira. Abagenyi ne beewuunya era ne bakwatibwa ensonyi olw’ekyo kye baatwala ng’ekikolwa eky’obutassa kitiibwa mu mukulu w’eggwanga. “Omwami oyo ayitibwa ani?” Gavana n’abuuza. “Ndowooza,” omuweereza n’addamu, “yaŋŋambye nti erinnya lye ye Stoddard.” “Bwe kiri?” Gavana n’agamba. “Munsonyiwe, abaami, bw’aba nga ye Col. Stoddard, kiŋŋwanidde okugenda gy’ali.” (Okuva mu Dwight’s Travels, Omuzingo I, olupapula 332, ekijulizibwa Trumbull, op. cit. olupapula 173.) Okufa kwe kwaggyawo omu ku bawagizi ba Edwards abasinga amaanyi era kiyinzika kwayamba ku nkomerero ey’ennaku ey’empaka ennene omubuulizi mwe yali kaakano. Ku nsonga eno kya kwewuunya okulaba nti Kolonelo Stoddard mu 1736 yayamba okugereka ekitundu ky’e Stockbridge era nti yalina kinene kye yakola mu kutandikawo omulimu gw’obubaka eri Abayindi eyo, Edwards gwe yayitibwa okukulembera oluvannyuma lw’okugobwa e Northampton. Obubaka bwa Edwards bwa kutendereza, naye waliwo buli nsonga okulowooza nti okutwalira awamu buwa endowooza entuufu ku mpisa ya Stoddard, emirimu gye, n’ebyo bye yatuukako. Ku ye, laba nate Trumbull, op. cit. Omuzingo II, Essuula 13.

116. Olutalo luno. Olutalo lwa Kabaka George olw’Abafalansa n’Abayindi (1744-1748-9). Kolonelo Stoddard, ng’omuduumizi w’amagye g’e Hampshire, yakulemberanga emirimu gy’amagye mu kitundu ekyo eky’ensi okutuusa lwe yafa. Major Israel Williams ow’e Hatfield, eyamuddira mu bigere oluvannyuma mu buduumizi, ng’awandiika nga 25 Juuni, 1748, eri Omuwandiisi Willard, agamba nti: “Kaakano tuli ng’endiga ezitaliiko musumba.... Katonda asiimye okumutuggyako (eyali ekitundu ekinene ennyo amagezi gaffe n’amaanyi gaffe n’ekitiibwa kyaffe) mu kiseera we twali tusinga okumwetaaga.” (Trumbull, op. cit. Omuzingo II, olupapula 158.)

OBUBAKA BW’OKUSIIBULA

118. Obubaka bw’Okusiibula. “Obubaka bw’Okusiibula Obwabuulirwa mu Kitundu ekisooka e Northampton, Oluvannyuma lw’Abantu Okugaana mu lwatu Omuweereza waabwe, n’okulekayo Enkolagana yaabwe naye ng’Omusumba w’Ekkanisa eyo, nga 22 Juuni 1750 Olw’Enjawukana mu Ndowooza, ku Bisaanyizo ebyetaagisa eby’Abammemba b’Ekkanisa, Abajjuvu. Bwa Jonathan Edwards, A.M. Ebikolwa 20:18. Mumanyi bulungi ng’okuva ku lunaku lwe natuukirako mu Asiya, nga bwe nnabeeranga nammwe, mu biseera byonna. olunyiriri 20. Era nga bwe saalekayo kubabuulira bituufu eby’okubayamba, wabula ne mbalaga, ne mbayigiriza mu lwatu, ne mu maka gammwe. olunyiriri 26, 27. Noolwekyo mbategeeza leero nti sirina kyenvunaanwa olw’omusaayi gwa bonna: kubanga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mbabuulira okwagala kwa Katonda. Abaggalatiya 4:15, 16. Kale essanyu lyammwe lyadda wa? Kubanga ndi mujulirwa wammwe nti, mwali musobola okuggyamu amaaso gammwe ne mugampa singa kyali kisoboka. Kale kaakano nfuuse omulabe wammwe olw’okubategeeza amazima? Boston Bwakubibwa era bwatundibwa S. Kneeland okwolekera Ekkomera ku Luguudo lwa Queen. 1751.”—Olupapula olw’omutwe olw’enfulumya eyasooka.

Ennyanjula y’obubaka buno kiwandiiko kikulu nnyo mu kubutegeera, ne kiba nti wano, nga bwe kitera okukolebwa ne mu nfulumya endala, kikubiddwa mu bujjuvu.

Ennyanjula. Si kya kwewuunya, abamu ku basomi b’obubaka buno obuddako okwagala okumanya embeera z’enjawukana wakati wange n’abantu b’e Northampton, eyavaamu okwawukana wakati wange nabo, okwaleeta okubuulira obubaka buno obw’okusiibula. Tewali, n’akatono, bbanga wano okunnyonnyola ensonga eyo mu bujjuvu: naye kirabika nga kisaanidde, era nga kyetaagisa, wano okutereeza okunnyonnyola okumu okukyamu ennyo, okwakoleddwa ennyo, era (kityibwa nti) abamu mu bugenderevu n’obunyiikivu, ku njawukana eyo: nga, nti nnakaatiriza abantu okuba abakakafu nti bali mu mbeera ey’obulokozi, nsobole okubakkiriza mu kkanisa; nti nnetaaga okunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu enkola n’entegeka y’obumanyirivu bw’omuntu obw’omunda, n’ekiseera n’engeri y’okukyuka kwe, ng’ekigezo ky’okusaanira kwe okussa ekimu okw’Ekikristaayo; weewaawo, nti nnagezaako okutandikawo ekkanisa ennongoofu, n’okwawula mu butuufu era mu bukakafu abatukuvu ku bannanfuusi, olw’okwefuula okwawula okutasobya [okw’]embeera y’emmeeme z’abantu; nti mu bintu bino nnali neegasse ku bantu abo abatali bateefu, abaalabise gye buvuddeko mu New England, abayitibwa Abeeyawula; era nti nze kennyini nnali mfuuse Omweyawuzi omukulu; era nti nneetwalira obuyinza bwonna obw’okusalawo ku bisaanyizo by’abo abaagala okussa ekimu nze nzekka, era ne nkaatiriza okukola olw’obuyinza bwange bwokka, mu kukkiriza abammemba mu kkanisa, n’ebirala.

Mu kuwakanya okunnyonnyola kuno okw’obuwaayiro, kaakano nja kuwa omusomi wange kunnyonnyola kwokka ebintu ebimu bye nnateeka mu maaso g’olukiiko, olwatwawula nze n’abantu bange, basobole okuba n’endowooza entuufu era enzijuvu ku misingi gyange egikwata ku nsonga eyali mu mpaka.

Nga wakyali wala nnyo olukiiko lutannatuula, abantu bange baali batumye eri Omwami Clark Ow’ekitiibwa ow’omu kyalo ky’e Salem, nga bamusaba awandiike ng’awakanya emisingi gyange. Ekyo kyampa omukisa okuwandiikira Omwami Clark, alyoke afune amawulire amatuufu ku misingi gyange kye giri. Era mu kiseera olukiiko we lwatuulira, nnakola, olw’okubamanyisa, okulangirira mu lwatu emisingi gyange mu maaso gaabwe n’ekkanisa, mu nnyumba y’okusabiramu, okw’amakulu ge gamu n’ago mu bbaluwa yange eri Omwami Clark, era kumpi mu bigambo bye bimu: era awo, oluvannyuma, ne mpeereza olukiiko mu buwandiike, ekitundu ky’ebbaluwa eyo, ekirimu amawulire ge nnali mpadde Omwami Clark, mu bigambo byennyini eby’ebbaluwa yange gy’ali, olukiiko lusobole okukisoma n’okukirowoozaako mu kiseera kyalwo, era lube n’okumanya okusingawo obukakafu n’okumatiza ku misingi gyange kye giri. Ekitundu kye nnabaweereza kyali mu bigambo bino:

“Emirundi mingi era simanyi oba si kumpi wonna, mu nsi, njogerwako ng’alina endowooza empya era ey’ekyewuunyo ku bisaanyizo by’okussa ekimu okw’Ekikristaayo, era ng’ayagala okuleeta engeri ey’enjawulo eyange ku bubwange.
