So nga sirowooza nti nnawukana n’akatono ku nteekateeka ya Dr. Watts mu kitabo kye ekiyitibwa, The Rational Foundation of a Christian Church, and the Terms of Christian Communion; gy’agamba nti y’endowooza ey’ekkanisa zonna ezaazzibwa obuggya. Nnali sinnalaba kitabo kino ekya Dr. Watts bwe nnafulumya bye mpandiise ku nsonga eno. Naye ndowooza nti endowooza zange, nga bwe nzoogedde, zikwatagana ddala n’ebyo by’ateekawo, nga gy’obeera nti nnali muyizi we. So sisukka n’akatono ebyo Dr. Doddridge by’alaga mu lwatu nti ze ndowooza ze, mu Rise and Progress of Religion ye, ne mu Sermons on Regeneration ze, ne mu Kunnyonnyola kwe n’Ebinnyonnyola ku Ndagaano Empya. Era mazima, ssebo, bwe ndowooza ku ndowooza z’olaze mu bbaluwa zo eri Major Pomroy n’Omwami Billing, sisobola kulaba wabula nti zituuka ddala ku kintu kye kimu kye nkuuma. Olowooza nti amasakramentu si mateeka ga kukyusa: wabula nti, ‘ng’obubonero bw’endagaano, gatwala nti okukyuka kwasooka kubaawo, naddala mu bakulu; era nti obutukuvu obulabika, oba, mu bigambo ebirala, okwatula okukkirizika okw’okukkiriza n’okwenenya, okukkiriza okw’ekitiibwa endagaano y’enjiri, nga kwegattiddwako enneeyisa ennungi, n’ekipimo ekimala eky’okumanya okw’Ekikristaayo, kye kiwa eddembe ery’enjiri eri amateeka gonna amatukuvu: naye nti kyetaagisa eri abo abajja eri amateeka gano, ne mu abo abeeyatula okukkiriza endagaano y’enjiri, okuba ab’amazima mu kwatula kwabwe,’ oba waakiri okwerowooza nti bali bwe batyo.—Ekintu ekikulu kye mbadde mbuusabuusa mu nkola eyateekebwawo ey’ekkanisa eno, era gye siguma kweyongerayo kugikola, kwe kukkiriza kwabwe mu lwatu ebigambo ebiddibwamu ku mukolo gw’okukkirizibwa kwabwe mu kussa ekimu, awatali kwefuula okutegeeza mu kyo ekintu kyonna ng’okukkiriza okw’omutima endagaano y’enjiri, oba okutegeeza okukkiriza oba okwenenya kwonna ng’okwo okwa ndagaano ey’ekisa, era nga bye bisaanyizo ebikulu eby’endagaano eyo: kubanga, mu kiseera kye kimu ebigambo we bikozesebwa, gwe musingi gwabwe ogumanyiddwa era ogwateekebwawo gwe beeyatula mu lwatu era gwe bagoberera, nti abantu bayinza era basaanidde okukozesa ebigambo bino nga tebategeeza kintu ng’ekyo, wabula ekintu ekirala eky’engeri eya wansi ennyo; kye ndowooza nti tebalina ndowooza ntegeerekeka, enkakafu ku kyo; wabula ekintu ekikkiriziganya n’okumanya kwabwe nti tebalonda Katonda ng’obulungi bwabwe obusingayo, wabula baagala ensi okumusinga, era nti tebeewaayo ddala eri Katonda, wabula beekuumira ebimu; era mu bufunze, nga bamanyi nti tebakkiriza na mutima ndagaano ya njiri, wabula bakyabeera wansi w’obuyinza obufuga obw’okwagala ensi, n’obulabe eri Katonda ne Kristo. Ne kiba nti ebigambo by’okwatula kwabwe okw’olwatu, okusinziira ku nkozesa yaabyo eyateekebwawo mu lwatu, biba tebikyali bya ngeri ya kwatula kwonna okw’okukkiriza n’okwenenya okw’enjiri, oba okugondera kwonna okutuufu endagaano: kubanga kwe kwatula kwabwe, nti ebigambo, nga bwe bikozesebwa, tebitegeeza kintu ng’ekyo. Ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu mbeera eno, waakiri tebituuka kuba kwatula okukkirizika okw’ebintu bino. Sisobola kulowooza ku bulungi ng’obwo mu bigambo ebimu, nti kisaanidde, olw’okwogera amaloboozi gano kwokka, okukkiriza abantu mu masakramentu ag’Ekikristaayo, awatali kufaayo ku makulu gonna ag’amaloboozi gano ge beefuula okutegeeza: so sisobola kulowooza nti etteeka lyonna erya Kristo lyateekawo ebisaanyizo ng’ebyo eby’okukkirizibwa mu kkanisa y’Ekikristaayo. Tekiri mu mpaka wakati wange n’abantu bange, okwatula okwetaagibwa nga kwa bujjuvu oba kugazi kwenkana wa. Sandyagadde kusibibwa ku bukomera obutuufu ku nsonga eyo; wabula okusinga okuwakana, nandimatidde n’ebigambo bitono, ebyogera mu bufunze empisa ennungi enkulu oba ebikolwa ebiri mu kugondera n’omutima endagaano, ebyogeddwa (nga bwe kyandirabise mu kunoonyereza ku kumanya kw’omuntu okw’enjigiriza) mu kutegeera; singa waaliwo enneeyisa ey’ebweru ekwatagana nabyo: weewaawo, nandirowoozezza, nti omuntu ng’oyo, ng’akola mu kitiibwa okwatula ng’okwo, yalina eddembe okukkirizibwa ng’ali mu kwagala kw’ekkanisa okw’olwatu, ne bw’aba nga ye kennyini abuusabuusa okukyuka kwe, olw’obutajjukira kiseera, obutamanya ngeri y’okukyuka kwe, oba okusanga ekibi kingi bwe kityo ekisigaddewo, n’ebirala. Era (singa okubuusabuusa kwe kwennyini tekwamuziyiza kujja ku mmeeza ya Mukama) nandirowoozezza nti omuweereza oba ekkanisa tebaalina ddembe kugaana mwatuzi ng’oyo, ne bw’aba ng’agamba nti tayinza kwerowooza nti akyuse; kubanga okwo nkuyita okwatula okutya Katonda, okuli okwatula ebintu ebikulu omuli okutya Katonda, so si kwatula ndowooza ye ku mbeera ye ennungi.”

Northampton, nga 7 Maayi, 1750.

Wano we ekoma Ebbaluwa yange eri Omwami Clark.

Olukiiko bwe lwawulira nti nnali nkoze ebiwandiiko ebimu eby’endagaano, oba engeri z’okwatula eddiini mu lwatu ze nnali neetegefu okukkiriza okuva eri abo abaagala okussa ekimu mu kkanisa, lwazitumya, olw’okwongera okumanya. Bwe ntyo ne mbaweereza ebiwandiiko oba engeri nnya ez’enjawulo, ze nnali ntegese nga omwaka gumu emabega, nga ze nnali neetegefu okukkiriza (emu ku zo yonna) okusinga okuwakana n’okwawukana n’abantu bange.

Engeri ebbiri ezisinga obumpi ku zino ziyingiziddwa wano olw’okumatiza omusomi. Ze zino.

“Nsuubira nti mazima nsanga omutima ogwewaayo ddala eri Katonda, okusinziira ku makulu g’endagaano eyo ey’ekisa eyassibwako akabonero mu kubatizibwa kwange; n’okutambulira mu kkubo ery’obuwulize eri ebiragiro byonna ebya Katonda, endagaano ey’ekisa bw’etaaga, ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwange.” Endala,

“Nsuubira nti mazima nsanga mu mutima gwange obwagazi okugondera ebiragiro byonna ebya Katonda, ebinneetaaza okwewaayo ddala gy’ali, n’okumuweereza n’omubiri gwange n’omwoyo gwange. Era bwe ntyo kaakano nsuubiza okutambulira mu kkubo ery’obuwulize eri ebiragiro byonna ebya Katonda, ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwange.”

Okwatula okw’engeri eno nnali neetegefu okukukkiriza, okusinga okuwakana n’okwawukana n’abantu bange. Si nti sirowooza nti kisinga nnyo okusaanira, nti ebiseera ebisinga okwatula eddiini mu lwatu Abakristaayo kwe bakola kubeere kujjuvu nnyo era kwa bulambulukufu okusingawo; era nti (nga bwe nnalaga mu bbaluwa yange eri Omwami Clark) sandyagadde kusibibwa ku ngeri yonna enkakafu ey’ebigambo, wabula okuba n’eddembe okukyusakyusa ebigambo by’okwatula okw’olwatu okusobola okukwatagana ddala n’endowooza n’obumanyirivu bw’omwatuzi, kulyoke kubeere kwogera okutuufu era okw’eddembe okusingawo okw’ekyo buli omu ky’asanga mu mutima gwe.

Era ate kiteekwa okumanyibwa, nti bulijjo nnakaatirizanga, nti kyali kyange ng’omusumba, okwatula nga tekunnaba kukkirizibwa, okuba n’eddembe ejjuvu okuyigiriza omwagazi amakulu g’ebigambo byakwo, n’obutonde bw’ebintu ebiteekeddwawo okwatulwa; n’okunoonyereza ku kutegeera kwe okw’enjigiriza ku bintu bino, okusinziira ku magezi gange agasinga obulungi; n’okulabula omuntu, nga bwe nnandirowoozezza nti kyetaagisa, ku bwangu mu kukola okwatula ng’okwo, oba okukukola okusinga olw’erinnya lye oba ery’amaka ge, oba olw’endowooza yonna ey’ensi, n’okumuteeka ku kwekebera okw’amaanyi, n’okunoonya mu mutima gwe, n’okusaba Katonda amukebere era amutangaaze aleme kuba munnanfuusi era alimbibwa mu kwatula kw’akola; wamu n’okumulaga amakubo amangi abeeyatuzi mwe bayinza okulimbibwa.

So sirowooza nti tekisaanidde omuweereza mu nsonga ng’eyo, okubuuza n’okumanya okuva eri omwagazi ekiyinza okujjukirwa ku mbeera z’obumanyirivu bwe obw’Ekikristaayo; kubanga kino kiyinza okuyamba ennyo okunnyonnyola okwatula kwe n’okuwa omuweereza omukisa omunene ogw’okuyigiriza okusaanidde: newakubadde nga okumanya okw’enjawulo n’okujjukira ekiseera n’engeri y’okukyuka okwasooka okudda eri Katonda tekusaanidde kufuulibwa kigezo ky’amazima g’omuntu, so tekusaanidde kukaatirizibwa ng’ekyetaagisa okusobola okukkirizibwa mu kwagala okujjuvu. Si nti ndowooza nti tekisaanidde n’akatono oba tekigasa, nti mu mbeera ezimu ez’enjawulo okulangirira embeera ez’enjawulo ez’okuzuukusibwa kw’omuntu okwasooka n’engeri y’okukakasibwa kwe, okutangaazibwa kwe n’okubudaabudibwa kwe, kulagibwe mu lwatu mu maaso g’ekibiina kyonna, ku mukolo gw’okukkirizibwa kwe mu kkanisa; newakubadde nga kino tekyetaagibwa ng’ekyetaagisa okukkirizibwa. Bulijjo nnangirira nga mpakanya okukaatiriza okunnyonnyola obumanyirivu, mu makulu gano (kwe kugamba, okunnyonnyola ekiseera eky’enjawulo n’amadaala g’omulimu gw’Omwoyo mu kukyuka okwasooka), ng’ekisaanyizo ky’okussa ekimu: naye, singa okunnyonnyola obumanyirivu kutegeeza okulangirira obumanyirivu bw’ebintu ebinene ebyakolebwa, ekisa eky’amazima n’ebikolwa n’empisa ez’obutukuvu enkulu mwe biri; mu makulu gano, ndowooza nti okunnyonnyola obumanyirivu bw’omuntu kyetaagisa okusobola okukkirizibwa kwe mu kussa ekimu okujjuvu mu kkanisa. Naye nti mu kunoonyereza kwonna okukolebwa, ne mu kunnyonnyola kwonna okuweebwa, omuweereza wadde ekkanisa tebasaanidde kwefuula bakebera mitima, wabula basaanidde okukkiriza okwatula okw’amaanyi, okw’ekitiibwa okw’omwatuzi ayigiriziddwa obulungi, ow’obulamu obulungi, ng’asinga okusobola okumanya ky’asanga mu mutima gwe.

Ebintu bino biyinza okuyamba mu kigero ekimu okutereeza abo ku basomi bange ababuziddwa mu ndowooza zaabwe ku mbeera y’empaka wakati wange n’abantu bange, olw’okunnyonnyola okukyamu okwogeddwako waggulu.

Jonathan Edwards.

135. Naye kiyinzika ennyo nti kino tekiriddamu kubaawo nate. Oluusi kigambibwa nti Edwards teyaddamu kubuulira mu kituuti e Northampton. Kino si kya mazima. Yabuulira, mazima, Ssande kkumi na bbiri, newakubadde, mazima, si nga zaddiriŋŋana era nga bwe kyabanga tekisoboka kufuna babuulizi balala, nga tannasenguka kugenda e Stockbridge. Waliwo oboolyawo ensonga esingako ku kigambo kya Dr. Hopkins, ekijulizibwa Dwight (op. cit. olupapula 418), nti ekibuga ku nkomerero—kirowoozebwa nti mu Novemba, 1750—kyasalawo nti alekere awo okubuulira. Naye ebiwandiiko by’ekibuga n’eby’ekitundu byombi bisirise ku nsonga eno, obululu bwokka obukwatagana nayo nga bwe bwasalibwawo ekitundu mu Novemba, “okusasula Omwami Edwards £10 old tenor buli Ssabbiiti olw’ekiseera kye yabuulira wano okuva lwe yagobwa.” Trumbull, eyakakasa kino (History of Northampton, Omuzingo II, olupapula 227), agamba nti obubaka obwasembayo Edwards bwe yabuulira e Northampton bwali olweggulo nga 13 Okitobba, 1751, okuva mu kyawandiikibwa Abaebbulaniya 11:16. Naye ne kino kibuusibwabuusibwa; kubanga mu biwandiiko eby’omukono e New Haven, Pulofeesa Dexter yazuula obubaka ku 2 Abakkolinso 4:6 obwawandiikibwako nti bwabuulirwa e Northampton, Maayi 1755, ne mu kitabo ky’enteekateeka z’obubaka waakiri ebiwandiiko bisatu eby’ebyawandiikibwa n’enjigiriza eby’ekiseera kye kimu ebyawandiikibwako nti byategekerwa Northampton. (F. B. Dexter, The Manuscripts of Jonathan Edwards, olupapula 8.)

145. Olw’ebyo ne nfuuka omukyayibwa bwe ntyo. Okusasamala kw’Okuzuukuka Okunene kwaddirirwa ekiseera eky’obulagajjavu. Mu 1744 Edwards yategeezebwa nti abavubuka abawerako ab’ekibiina kye, abalenzi n’abawala, baali basoma ebitabo eby’obugwenyufu, ebyakuza okunyumya okw’obukaba n’okw’obuwemu. Okuziyiza obubi buno, yabuulira obubaka, obw’obwesimbu bwabwo bwe tuyinza okusalako okuva ku bubaka obwafulumizibwa ku “Kukemebwa kwa Yusufu,” okuva mu Abaebbulaniya 12:15, 16, era oluvannyuma lw’okusinza n’ategeeza ab’oluganda ab’ekkanisa obujulizi bwe yalina ng’ayagala okwongera okubaako ky’akola. Akakiiko ak’okunoonyereza kaalondebwa okuyamba omusumba mu kukebera ensonga eno mu lukuŋŋaana mu nnyumba ye. Awo Edwards n’asoma amannya g’abavubuka abaali ab’okuyitibwa ng’abajulirwa oba ng’abavunaanibwa, naye nga tayawudde wakati w’ebibinja ebyo ebibiri. Amannya bwe gaalangirirwa bwe gatyo, ne kizuulibwa nti amaka agasinga obukulu mu kibuga gaali gakwatibwako. “Ekibuga kyonna mangu ago ne kikwata omuliro.” Abakulu b’amaka bangi ne bagaana okugenda mu maaso n’okunoonyereza; abavubuka bangi abaayitibwa mu lukuŋŋaana ne bagaana okujja, n’abo abajja ne beeyisa n’ekyejo. Okuva olwo Edwards teyaddamu kusobola kuzzaawo buyinza bwe. Okumala emyaka tewaali mwagazi n’omu eyajja okukkirizibwa mu kkanisa. Laba Hopkins, Life of Edwards (1765), olupapula 53 n’ezigoberera. Dwight, op. cit. olupapula 299 n’oluddako, akoppa okunnyonnyola kwa Hopkins kumpi kigambo ku kigambo, naye nga takkiriza nti kwe yakoppa.

146. Emirundi n’emirundi mbalabudde ... lwe tulisisinkana mu maaso ge. Okutambulatambula wamu n’eby’amasanyu eby’ensi eby’abavubuka byali bya kwemulugunya okw’edda eri Edwards. Ng’awandiika ku kiseera ekyakulembera okuzuukuka kwa 1734-1735, agamba nti, “Yali mpisa yaabwe emirundi mingi nnyo okukuŋŋaana mu nkuŋŋaana ez’abalenzi n’abawala, olw’okusanyuka n’okuzannya, ze baayitanga ebinyumu; era emirundi mingi baamalangamu ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky’ekiro, nga tebafaayo ku ntegeka mu maka mwe baava.” Abavubuka nga bwe beesanyusanga mu “nkuŋŋaana” zino, tusobola kulowooza bulowooza; kikakafu nti abamu, waakiri, ku bazadde tebaalaba kabi mu zo. Naye endowooza ya Edwards ku kufuga amaka yali ya njawulo nnyo. “Teyakkirizanga baana be kubeera bweru wa waka oluvannyuma lw’essaawa ssatu ez’ekiro, bwe baagendanga okulaba mikwano gyabwe n’ababeera nabo. So tebaakkirizibwanga kusigala nga batudde ennyo oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera ekyo, mu nnyumba ye, omuntu yenna bwe yajjanga okubakyalira. Omwami yenna bwe yayagalanga okumanyagana ne bawala be, oluvannyuma lw’okweyanjula obulungi, ng’ayogera n’abazadde nga bwe kisaanidde, yakkirizibwanga omukisa gwonna ogusaanidde olw’ekyo: ekisenge n’omuliro, bwe kyabanga kyetaagisa; naye teyalinanga kuyingirira ssaawa ezisaanidde ez’okuwummula n’okwebaka, oba eddiini n’entegeka y’amaka.” (Hopkins, op. cit. olupapula 44.) Tulina ensonga okulowooza nti agamu ku “ddembe eddala abavubuka lye batera okwetwalira mu nsi” gaali gategekeddwa okuwagira buli kimu okusinga empisa ennungi n’eby’omwoyo.

149. Omwoyo ogw’okuyomba. Ebyafaayo mu ngeri ey’awamu bikakasa obujulirwa buno obuddako obwa Edwards ku mwoyo ogw’okuyomba mu bantu b’e Northampton: “Waaliwo empaka ennene n’okukaayana mu bo mu mulembe gw’Omwami Stoddard, ebyakolebwanga n’ebbugumu lingi n’obukambwe; okuyomba okunene mu kkanisa, Omwami Stoddard, newakubadde nga yalina obuyinza bungi, mwe yali tamanyi kya kubakolera. Mu mpaka emu ey’ekkanisa mu mulembe gw’Omwami Stoddard, ekkanisa mwe yayawukanira mu bibinja bibiri, ebbugumu ly’omwoyo lyalinnya okutuuka ku ddaala, ne kituuka ku kukubagana ennyo. Omu ku kibinja ekimu yasisinkana omukulu w’ekibinja ekirala n’amulumba n’amukuba awatali kusaasira. Wabaddewo okumala emyaka amakumi ana oba ataano enjawukana enywevu ey’abantu mu bibinja bibiri, ezifaanako n’ekibinja kya Kkooti n’ekya Ensi mu Bungereza (bwe kiba nga nsobola okugeraageranya ebintu ebitono n’ebinene). Wabaddewo abamu ku basajja abakulu mu kibuga, ab’obuyinza obusinga n’obugagga, abaali bannannyini ttaka lingi, ababadde n’ekibinja kimu nabo. N’ekibinja ekirala, ekibadde kitera okuba ekisinga obunene, kibadde kya abo ababadde babakwatirwa obuggya, abatera okubakwatirwa ensaalwa, era abatya nti baliko obuyinza n’amaanyi bingi nnyo mu kibuga ne mu kkanisa. Kino kibadde musingi gw’okuyomba okutabalika mu bantu, emirundi n’emirundi, okubadde kunnakuwaza nnyo ddala, era Katonda kw’abadde anyiiziddwa awatali kubuusabuusa mu ngeri ey’entiisa, n’Omwoyo we n’anakuwazibwa n’azikizibwa, era okutabulwa kungi n’ebikolwa ebibi bingi ne biyingizibwa.” Ebbaluwa ey’olunaku 1 Julaay, 1751 eri Rev. Thomas Gillespie. Geraageranya ne Trumbull, History of Northampton, Omuzingo II, olupapula 36.

Tekisoboka wano okuyingira mu byafaayo by’empaka zino ezimanyiddwa ennyo. Ebimu ku zo bijja kusangibwa mu binnyonnyola, olupapula 172 n’ezigoberera; Dwight, op. cit., empapula 298-448, akuba mu bujjuvu ebiwandiiko okuva mu Kitabo ky’Ebyafaayo kya Edwards; ebiwandiiko by’ekkanisa bisirise. Kiyinza okwogerwa, oboolyawo, mu bwenkanya eri abantu b’e Northampton, nti enkolagana y’obusumba mu kiseera ekyo teyatwalibwanga, nga bwe kitera okulowoozebwa, ng’etasobola kusattululwa; abakulu b’eddiini mukaaga “baagobwa” mu kkanisa eziriraanyeewo wakati wa 1721 ne 1755. Ate era, Edwards, newakubadde nga yali omubuulizi omumanyifu awatali kubuusabuusa, gye bali yali muweereza wa kitundu bweru; erinnya lye eddene ng’omumanyi w’eby’eddiini lyanywezebwa oluvannyuma. Geraageranya ne Trumbull, History of Northampton, II, 225. Era si kya butali magezi okulowooza nti obusobozi bw’omwoyo obw’abantu bwali busikiriziddwa ekisukkiridde. Okwenenya okw’oluvannyuma okwa Joseph Hawley (laba Dwight, op. cit., olupapula 421), kizibwe wa Edwards, eyakulembera ennyo mu kumuwakanya, kukwata ku mwoyo gw’okuwakanya kwokka; tekubuusabuusa nnyo amagezi, mu mbeera ezo, ag’okwawukana.

“Bwe mba nga ndi mu kabi ak’okugenda mu ggeyeena, nandisanyuse okumanya nga bwe kisoboka ennyo ku ntiisa yaayo. Bwe mba nga ndi mwangu nnyo okulagajjalira okufaayo okusaanidde okugyewala, oyo ankolera ekisa ekisinga obulungi y’oyo akola ennyo okunnaga amazima g’ensonga, ateeka obunaku bwange n’akabi kange mu maaso gange mu ngeri esinga okukwata ku mutima.”—Obubaka ku Bubonero Obwawula Omulimu gw’Omwoyo wa Katonda.
